jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Position Summary

ARCHER Systems is seeking an experienced and highly organized Project Manager. This role reports directly to the Mass Tort Operations Program Director and is responsible for owning end-to-end project delivery across ARCHER’s growing portfolio of pre-settlement technology initiatives.

The Project Manager will serve as the connective tissue between ARCHER’s technology teams, mass tort operations, law firm clients, and third-party integration partners. This individual will drive new projects through delivery, ensuring on-time execution, clear stakeholder communication, and disciplined RACI accountability across cross-functional teams. This is a highly visible role with direct interaction with executive leadership.

Position Location: Remote

Job Responsibilities

Project Planning & Delivery

Own project plans, timelines, milestones, and deliverable tracking across all assigned projects from initiation to go-live
Lead internal project kickoffs, requirements gathering sessions, and stakeholder alignment meetings, ensuring all parties understand scope, dependencies, and success criteria
Proactively identify blockers, risks, and critical path items; escalate to the Mass Tort Operations Program Director with recommended solutions
Maintain rigorous status update cadences (daily standups, weekly written updates, etc.)
Ensure handoffs between technology development (Zeal IT consultants and internal ARCHER dev team), operations, and client-facing teams are clearly defined and executed

Stakeholder & Client Management

Serve as the primary project point of contact for internal stakeholders
Maintain RACI matrices for all active projects; ensure all parties — including both ARCHER technology teams and operations (Mass Torts Operations, Client Services) understand their roles and remain within defined lanes
Prepare and deliver clear, executive-ready project status reports
Identify when leadership escalation is needed and facilitate prompt resolution of decisions that require executive input

Technology Project Coordination

Coordinate delivery across multiple concurrent workstreams including API integrations (inbound/outbound), data migration, document processing, and client portal development
Partner with the VP of Technology Special Projects and development team to translate business and operational requirements into actionable user stories and sprint deliverables
Track and manage project backlogs in coordination with technology (development leads; ensure stories are properly scoped, prioritized, and resourced)

Process & Governance

Implement and maintain project governance frameworks including charter documentation, scope management, change control logs, and formal close-out procedures
Ensure alignment between new pre-settlement projects and the broader post-settlement ecosystem to avoid duplication and maintain data integrity
Drive adoption of standard project management practices across the team including meeting documentation, action item tracking, and decision logging
Support the sales pipeline by providing project scoping estimates, integration timelines, and delivery capacity assessments for prospective AIM clients
Manage vendor and contractor relationships (e.g., Zeal IT consulting team) to ensure accountability and delivery against contracted scope

Required

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES

5+ years of project management experience, with demonstrated success delivering complex technology projects involving API integrations, data migration, or SaaS platform development
Experience managing cross-functional teams including software developers, operations staff, and external client/partner stakeholders simultaneously
Proven ability to develop and maintain project plans, RACI models, stakeholder communication plans, and executive-level status reporting
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical details into clear business language for senior leadership audiences
Experience managing third-party vendor and consulting team relationships
Proficiency with project management tools (Jira, or equivalent) and Microsoft 365 (Teams, SharePoint, Outlook, Excel)
Ability to manage ambiguity, multiple priorities, and fast-moving timelines in a high-growth environment

Preferred

Experience in legal technology, mass tort, personal injury, or claims administration industries
Familiarity with API integration concepts (REST APIs, MuleSoft, ETL pipelines) and cloud platforms (Azure)
Experience supporting client onboarding and integration projects with law firm or insurance clients
Background working in organizations that operate both proprietary technology platforms and managed services delivery
Exposure to Power BI or other data visualization/reporting tools from a project oversight perspective

Benefits

401(K) retirement plans with matching contributions.
Comprehensive health insurance coverage.
Dental and vision insurance plans.
Parental leave to support work-life balance.
Short-term and long-term disability coverage.

About Archer

ARCHER Systems is a leading technology-enabled legal services company that provides pre-settlement and post-settlement administration services for a single event, mass tort, and class action cases with the goal of helping claimants access their settlement proceeds more efficiently and quickly. The company plans to continue leveraging technology and top-tier talent to enhance customer service and offer new product lines and services.

ARCHER’s core offering is post-settlement Healthcare Lien Resolution Administration and QSF (Qualified Settlement Fund) Administration and payments processing for multi-claimant (mass tort and class action) litigation. Other services include claims administration, single event lien resolution, probate, and bankruptcy coordination, release administration, medical records review, plaintiff fact sheet, and other intake/census preparation and management. ARCHER enables law firms to focus on their litigation while ensuring that critical pre-settlement and post-settlement administration documents, services, business analytics, and reporting are handled efficiently and effectively.

jobs.description:
Turner & Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.

Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.

Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.

We are majority-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner & Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.

Job Description

About the Role

The Project Manager provides consulting services for our multi-use facility client account to help achieve the company's strategic business objectives.

This job is part of the Project Management function. They are responsible for the management of projects from initiation through completion. Projects consist of both ground up and facility infrastructure construction projects. Role may require up to 50% travel regionally predominantly in the Eastern/Central Time Zone.

What You’ll Do

Manage all areas of project management for singular real estate projects. This includes planning, design, construction, occupancy, and closeout.

Work directly with clients to prepare all elements of the project. This includes the scope of work, project delivery resource requirements, cost estimates & budget, work plan schedule & milestones, quality control, and risk identification.

Define the project delivery resources from pre-qualified lists or through the project qualification process. Conduct a standard request for proposals, complete bid evaluations, and recommend resources to clients.

Implement project documentation governance that is aligned with company and client requirements.

Ensure project data integrity and documentation is accurate, timely, and coordinated.

Direct the project delivery team by providing guidance and direction to achieve goals.

Create action plans to meet objectives, budget, and schedule. Track the progress of each project and report status and variances.

Demonstrate ability to identify project threats and develop risk mitigation and contingency plans. Implement action plans to reduce or eliminate project risks.

Apply in-depth knowledge of standard principles and techniques/procedures to accomplish complex assignments and provide innovative solutions.

Coach others and share in-depth knowledge of own job discipline and broad knowledge of several job disciplines within the function.

Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE (Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence) values. Work to build consensus and convince others to reach an agreement.

Impact a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities within own team and other related teams.

Qualifications

What You’ll Need

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future

Bachelor's Degree preferred with 5-8 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered. LEED AP, PMP, and/or CCM designation(s) preferred.
Ground up construction and MEP infrastructure experience is strongly desired.
Proficiency in MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook). Experience in Kahua or similar project management software and D365 or other Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platform.
Organizational skills with an advanced inquisitive mentality.
Sophisticated math skills. Ability to calculate mildly complex figures such as percentages, fractions, and other financial-related calculations.

Additional Information

Please be advised that effective January 1, 2025, CBRE Project Management and Turner & Townsend were consolidated into a single global business entity. As a candidate applying for a position, you should be aware that while your initial employment may be with Turner & Townsend PJM US LLC, you will subsequently transfer directly to Turner & Townsend at a date to be determined.

*SOX control responsibilities may be part of this role, which are to be adhered to where applicable.

On-site presence and requirements may change depending on our client's needs*

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.

We want our people to succeed both in work and life. To support this, we promote a healthy, productive, and flexible working environment that respects work-life balance.

Turner & Townsend is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and actively encourage applications from all sectors of the community.

Our mission is to deliver best-in-class data center solutions to hyperscale customers who share our commitment to sustainability, and to do so with an unwavering focus on efficiency, quality, and flexibility. Why Clients Choose Pivotal Consulting

We are a technology management consulting firm helping Fortune 500 companies improve their performance – we specialize in making People, Process, and Technology work together! What We Are Looking For

Our banking client is seeking a senior-level Project Manager with deep banking/financial services experience to lead the Deposit Regional Pricing
project—a strategic initiative to enable region- and channel-based deposit pricing across both Consumer and Business lines. This capability emerged as a critical dependency during the SAFE integration effort, specifically the need to price California members differently, and is now essential to competing for deposits at a marginal cost of funds and preparing for a future national pricing strategy. The successful candidate will own this project end to end, from discovery and design through execution, and will be accountable for aligning a wide range of cross-functional stakeholders around a shared plan, timeline, and set of deliverables.

Project Success Measures

Increased deposit growth
Improved member retention
New member acquisition
Higher net interest margin
Improved rate competitiveness
Greater market share in expanded markets

Key Project Dependencies

Origination and core systems capable of supporting regional and channel-based pricing
Clear member/market segmentation
Dynamic rate sheets and disclosures
New deposit products
Governance and compliance approvals
Frontline training
Website capability to display region-specific pricing

What You Will Do

Lead business discovery and requirements-gathering activities with cross-functional stakeholders.
Define, prioritize, maintain, and govern the project backlog throughout the implementation lifecycle.
Translate business requirements into epics, features, user stories, and detailed acceptance criteria.
Facilitate backlog refinement sessions, stakeholder reviews, and requirement-validation discussions.
Partner with the Project Manager to manage scope, dependencies, risks, assumptions, and delivery milestones.
Serve as the primary business liaison between internal stakeholders, technology delivery teams, and vendor partners.
Ensure requirements and delivered solutions align with business objectives, operational needs, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Support user acceptance testing, including test-scenario development, defect triage, stakeholder coordination, and validation of completed functionality.
Support implementation planning, readiness activities, and post-implementation stabilization as needed.
Maintain clear documentation of decisions, requirements, priorities, and changes throughout the project lifecycle.

What Makes You a Good Fit

Lead the project through discovery, design, and execution, developing and managing an integrated project plan, budget, schedule, and scope across all workstreams.
Drive alignment across cross-functional stakeholders and teams—including Finance/Treasury, Deposit Products, Marketing, Digital/Web, Core/Origination Systems, Risk, Compliance, and Frontline training—to a shared timeline and set of deliverables.
Maintain systems dependency awareness across origination and core platforms, ensuring the technical roadmap can support regional and channel-based pricing, dynamic rate sheets, and disclosures.
Partner with Compliance, Legal, and Risk to secure governance and regulatory approvals required for new deposit products and region-specific pricing and disclosures.
Oversee the segmentation strategy and coordinate the creation of new deposit products and dynamic rate sheets needed to support regional and channel pricing.
Coordinate with Digital/Web teams to ensure the website and digital channels can display and support region-specific pricing.
Plan and oversee frontline training and change management so branch and service teams can execute the new pricing model accurately and confidently.
Identify, track, and mitigate project risks and issues, escalating proactively with clear options and recommendations.
Deliver executive-ready status reporting, including progress against success measures (deposit growth, retention, member acquisition, net interest margin, rate competitiveness, and market share), to project sponsors and steering committee.

Qualifications

Must-Have Qualifications

Financial services industry background.
Excellent core project management skills, including budget, schedule, scope, and people management.
Deposit product experience, or experience in a closely related banking/credit union product area.

Strongly Preferred Qualifications

Demonstrated experience leading projects through the full lifecycle—discovery, design, and execution.
Strong stakeholder engagement skills and executive presence.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment and team collaboration.
Awareness of systems dependencies and how technology constraints affect project delivery.
Strong focus on risk, compliance, and governance considerations.
Excellent, executive-ready written and verbal communication skills.

Why Our Employees Love Working At Pivotal

We believe our strength comes from our differences, and as a Certified Minority-Owned Business (MBE) and a majority women-led firm, we are committed to fostering and promoting a culture of diversity and inclusion. We believe our team and our community are our greatest assets and we strive to promote both daily.

Always Better – We continuously evolve, inspired to drive beyond the everyday norm.

This is a senior role with full accountability for project outcomes across safety, schedule, budget, quality, and client relationships on projects including large-diameter pipeline installations, pump stations, deep utility systems, and heavy civil work.

This is a hybrid position with time split between the office, home, and project sites. S.J. Louis covers all project-related travel expenses and pays a daily per diem for overnight assignments.

Key Responsibilities

Project Execution

Manage all project phases from planning and procurement through construction, startup, and closeout
Set up project team structure, communication schedules, and decision-making processes
Coordinate subcontractors, engineers, inspectors, vendors, and municipal stakeholders
Lead owner-architect-contractor meetings and serve as the main point of contact for clients
Mentor and develop Project Engineers and Project Managers on the team

Financial Management

Manage project budget, cost forecasting, and margin performance
Lead subcontractor buyout and handle contract administration
Process and negotiate change orders from identification through documentation and approval
Approve invoices and keep job cost reporting accurate and current

Schedule and Technical Oversight

Build and manage CPM schedules, milestone plans, and rolling look-aheads
Coordinate long-lead procurement to protect the schedule
Review and interpret civil, structural, mechanical, and utility drawings
Oversee construction sequencing for critical tie-ins, shutdowns, and bypass operations
Identify and work through field conflicts and constructability issues early

Safety and Quality

Enforce OSHA standards, company safety policies, and applicable municipal utility requirements
Set quality expectations at project start and verify work through inspections and documentation
Maintain complete project records that support decision-making and protect against claims

Required Experience

10 to 15 years of construction project management experience in heavy civil or underground utility work
At least 7 years managing projects involving underground utilities, large-diameter pipelines, pump stations, or heavy civil infrastructure
Experience managing projects valued at $10M to $50M or more
Strong working knowledge of gravity sewer, force mains, water mains, large-diameter pipelines (48-inch and larger), deep excavation, shoring, dewatering, and trenchless methods
Experience with FRP/GRP, PCCP, ductile iron, HDPE, and steel casing pipe systems
Background in CPM scheduling, budget management, change order control, and subcontractor management
Experience managing construction in active municipal environments and public right-of-way

Technical Knowledge and Tools

Proficient in Procore and Bluebeam
Proficient in Primavera P6 and/or Microsoft Project
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, Teams)
Able to read and interpret civil, structural, mechanical, and utility drawings
Familiar with municipal utility standards, specifications, and permitting

Preferred Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, or a related field (equivalent field experience considered)
OSHA 30 Certification
PMP Certification or equivalent advanced project management training
Experience with design-build or CMAR project delivery
Estimating background

Salary, Benefits And Total Compensation

S.J. Louis offers a competitive compensation package for experienced senior leaders. Salary starts at $140,000 and is based on experience and qualifications.

Base Salary: Starting at $140,000 annually
Company-paid travel and lodging for all project assignments away from home
Daily per diem for overnight project assignments
Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
401(k) retirement plan
Company-paid Life Insurance
Health Savings Account (HSA)
Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
Paid Time Off (PTO)

What We're Looking For

We are looking for a senior construction professional with deep experience managing heavy civil and underground utility projects. The right candidate has a strong technical background, manages budgets and schedules with discipline, and builds solid working relationships with clients, engineers, and field crews. If you have a consistent record of delivering complex projects on time and on budget, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:

Research Administration Specialist 3

Job Family:

Research Administration

Time Type:

Full time

Apply before 11:59 PM Arizona time the day before the posted End Date.

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree and five (5) years of experience appropriate to the area of assignment/field; OR, Any equivalent combination of experience and/or training from which comparable knowledge, skills and abilities have been achieved.

Job Profile Summary:

Responsible for collaborating with faculty and researchers in managing intermediate to complex aspects of proposal development, development of financial resources and programs, and ensuring compliance with university policies.

Job Description:

Position Salary Range:
$62,000 - $82,000 per year; DOE

Job Description
:

The Center for Broadening Participation in STEM (CBP-STEM) is looking for a Project Manager Research to work closely and collaboratively with Principal Investigator(s), research team, and other stakeholders to plan, direct, organize, and execute against project requirements; identify and acquire necessary resources and coordinates efforts by all parties to ensure timely delivery of project outcomes in accordance with the sponsoring source's expectations.

Essential Duties:

Plans, develops, implements, and manages a project team through complete task definitions and work requirement identification and assignments.
Works closely and collaboratively with key stakeholders to define project scope, strategy, budget, and outcomes; identifies critical resource expertise and targets appropriate internal and/or external sources to ensure optimal outcome(s).
Establishes and continually monitors/manages project expectations with team; assigns tasks and identifies issues for resolution to ensure optimal team effectiveness.
Prepares and maintains all project status reports and schedules; tracks milestones/deliverables, critical paths and dependencies; re-sets expectations as needed in consideration of project progress/outcomes.
Responds to all inquiries regarding project status; prepares all regulatory reporting/filings to ensure compliance.
Manages, coaches, and supervises all project team members both internal and contracted to ensure optimal outcomes; builds, develops, and maintains relationships vital to project success. Works collaboratively with Principal Investigator(s) to engage leadership, associated scientists and other research related staff to define and identify all required project infrastructure.
Prepares all post-project reports, budget allocations and summaries/filings to ensure timely dissemination of information to all interested parties.
Coordinates project activities; assists in execution. Identifies trends, anticipates and responds to project risks and results.
Organizes tasks, responsibilities and outcomes; documents activities and tracks progress. Prepares and summarizes project budgets.
Fosters team effectiveness by acting to develop an environment that promotes the effectiveness and morale of the team.

Experience facilitating programs, workshops, or professional development with community colleges and/or universities, particularly with faculty.
Knowledge of marketing principles and practices.
Strong customer service skills, including active listening, acknowledgment, and effective communication.
Strong skills in communication assessment, editing, research, and summarizing information.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present information effectively through oral, written, and digital/media formats.
Ability to work collaboratively with internal and external committees, faculty, staff, community members, and other stakeholders.
Knowledge and experience with artificial intelligence (AI), technology, and emerging digital tools are highly desired.
Strong organizational and administrative skills, with the ability to manage assigned administrative responsibilities and support program operations.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and work effectively both independently and as part of a team.

Grant Funded

jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager — Pipeline & Marketing Operations
jobs.description:
Meet the Moment with Alteryx

We're living through a once-in-a-generation shift in how work gets done. Data, automation, and AI are quickly becoming the center of every business decision - and Alteryx is leading the transformation.

You'll be working on the challenges that sit at the heart of modern business. No matter your role, the work you do will help organizations move faster, see more clearly, and tackle questions that used to feel impossible.

If you're ready to meet the moment with innovation, curiosity, and excellence, there's a place for you here.

This role is for a program/project manager who is genuinely fluent in how B2B marketing, sales, and revenue operations work together — someone who can sit in a room with Sales, RevOps, SDR, and Marketing leaders, understand the funnel and pipeline mechanics they're each accountable for, and drive the cross-functional discipline needed to close gaps between them. This is not a generalist project-management role: it requires real operating fluency in GTM motions, not just process facilitation.

Initially about one-third to one-half of this role's time will be dedicated to serving as the dedicated program/project manager for Alteryx's cross-functional Pipeline Health & Growth concentration, in close partnership with the SVP of Demand Generation. Over time, this role will also take on new projects/programs as needed and will be expected to help Marketing build a more consistent framework for managing priorities and work — administering tools like Asana and Confluence and introducing lightweight agile practices where they genuinely help. That broader mandate will grow as bandwidth allows.

Key Responsibilities

Drive the Pipeline Health & Growth Committee

Serve as the dedicated project/program manager for the cross-functional Pipeline Health & Growth Committee: own the cadence, agenda, action-item tracking, and follow-through.
Bring working fluency in the lead-to-opportunity journey, pipeline waterfall, funnel stage definitions, and attribution basics — enough to understand where gaps and handoff failures actually live, not just to schedule the meeting about them.
Hold cross-functional owners in Marketing, Sales, SDR/ADR, and RevOps accountable to commitments made in committee — without direct authority over those teams.
Partner closely with the SVP of Demand Generation to translate committee priorities into a working operating rhythm, and surface risks or blockers to the right leaders early.
Partner with data and insights team(s) to ensure cross-functional teams have the data, reporting and dashboards necessary to provide reliable visibility into pipeline health and committee progress.
Support other existing GTM funnel and pipeline cadences (e.g., pipeline or lead councils) with project-management rigor as needed.

Drive cross-functional programs and accountability, broadly

Partner across and outside of Marketing — with Sales, RevOps, and other GTM functions — to drive alignment and hold people accountable to shared priorities and deadlines without formal authority over them.
Take on additional cross-functional marketing/RevOps programs as delegated by marketing leadership.
Report on program and committee health to marketing and GTM leadership, distilling cross-functional complexity into concise, actionable updates.

Grow Marketing's operating framework over time

As bandwidth allows, help administer Asana (Marketing's system of record) and Confluence to give Marketing a more consistent way to track priorities and work across functions.
Introduce lightweight agile practices — prioritization rituals, backlog hygiene, retrospectives — where they genuinely reduce fragmentation, rather than applying a scaled framework wholesale.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of project or program management experience within B2B SaaS marketing operations, sales operations, or revenue operations — this domain fluency is the primary bar for this role.
Demonstrated working knowledge of GTM funnel mechanics: lead scoring, MQL/SQL definitions, pipeline waterfall, forecasting cadences, and attribution basics.
Proven ability to drive cross-functional alignment and hold stakeholders accountable across multiple teams, including outside one's own department, without direct authority.
Experience running or directly supporting a recurring, leadership-level cross-functional cadence or committee (e.g., a pipeline council, forecast call, or similar governance forum).
Comfortable operating in ambiguity, with a track record of standing up process and structure from scratch.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complex, cross-functional work into concise materials for senior leadership.
Highly accountable, organized, and solution-oriented, with genuine follow-through.

Preferred

Hands-on experience administering a work-management or PM tool (Asana, Jira, Aha, Monday, or similar) at a configuration/admin level — ideally Asana specifically, though strong admin experience in an adjacent tool is a legitimate substitute.
Working comfort in Confluence or similar documentation/knowledge-management tools.
Agile credential (e.g., CSPO) or hands-on experience running lightweight agile ceremonies; SAFe or scaled-agile exposure is a plus but not expected.
Experience with Salesforce or BI/reporting tooling (Tableau, Power BI, or similar).
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for an operator who already speaks the language of B2B marketing, sales, and RevOps — and who uses that fluency to drive real accountability, not just to run a well-organized meeting.

Someone who can walk into a room of Sales, SDR, RevOps, and Marketing leaders and immediately understand what's actually broken in the funnel — not just facilitate a conversation about it.
Confident holding peers and leaders accountable to commitments without formal authority over them, across and outside Marketing.
Comfortable managing upward — proactively communicating with senior stakeholders, including the SVP of Demand Generation and marketing leadership.
A builder who's comfortable standing up process and reporting from scratch, and who's genuinely curious about eventually helping Marketing build a broader, more consistent operating framework — without needing that to be day-one expertise.
Resilient and adaptable, comfortable with a role whose scope is explicitly expected to evolve over time.

Compensation

Alteryx is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation. Final compensation is determined by several factors, including but not limited to relevant work experience, education, certifications, skills, and geographic location.

The base salary range for this role in the United States is $120,000 - $135,000. This role is also eligible for a target annual bonus of 15% of base salary, based on individual and company performance.

In addition to base pay and bonus eligibility, this role includes:

A monthly Connectivity Plus stipend of $150 to support remote work-related expenses
An annual $200 home office reimbursement

Alteryx offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial security, and overall well-being, including:

Medical, dental, and vision coverage
401(k) with company match
Paid parental leave, caregiver leave, and flexible time off
Mental health support and wellness reimbursement
Career development and education assistance

Find yourself checking a lot of these boxes but doubting whether you should apply? At Alteryx, we support a growth mindset for our associates through all stages of their careers. If you meet some of the requirements and you share our values, we encourage you to apply. As part of our ongoing commitment to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace, we’re invested in building teams with a wide variety of backgrounds, identities, and experiences.

Benefits & Perks

Alteryx has amazing benefits for all Associates which can be viewed here.

At Quickbase, we help organizations build better ways to run their operations. Our products give teams the flexibility to create applications around how their work actually happens, connecting people, information, and processes so they can keep work moving as needs change.

For more than 25 years, organizations have turned to Quickbase to solve operational challenges that off-the-shelf software wasn't built for. Today, we’re building on that foundation with new products and new possibilities for how people create, adapt, and improve the systems their work depends on.

Working at Quickbase means helping find better ways forward. We’re a team of curious, collaborative people who care about solving problems, learning as we go, and building things that make work better for our customers and each other.

Lead complex digital platform initiatives across the organization by driving cross-functional coordination, technical program execution, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering, marketing, design, and IT teams to deliver scalable, high-performing web experiences and digital infrastructure aligned to business priorities.

Core Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end execution of digital platform and web infrastructure programs across multiple teams and stakeholders.
Drive alignment between business priorities, technical implementation, and delivery timelines to ensure successful execution of web initiatives.
Partner with engineering, marketing, design, analytics, and IT teams to coordinate dependencies, manage risks, and remove blockers.
Own program planning activities including roadmap coordination, prioritization, milestone tracking, and status reporting.
Facilitate agile program execution through sprint planning support, backlog coordination, release tracking, and delivery governance.
Establish and maintain program management best practices, documentation standards, communication cadences, and operational processes.
Support optimization and governance of the CMS and related digital tooling ecosystem.

jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Sep 18, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is looking for a Infrastructure Technical Program Manager to support and deploy one of the world’s largest and most complex telecommunication networks. The role is responsible for the execution of a strategic plan to improve the business processes and deployment of hyper-scaled cloud infrastructure, creation of a quality control system for North and South America (NASA), pre/post-inspections for design validation, and piloting stakeholder communication for delivery schedules. This opportunity is within the Global Connectivity Infrastructure Delivery - Fiber Deployment organization, which is responsible for project management, quality and delivery of fiber capacity for the physical network solutions that drive Amazon’s internal infrastructure and connect our services to the world.

Key job responsibilities

Reporting and Leadership: Reports to NASA GCID-FD Deployment Manager; provides regular updates to NASA and Global Senior management
Strategic Partnership: Serves as key member of North/South America GCID-FD team, driving overall Network Infrastructure strategy
Vendor Management: Manages vendor delivery timelines, measures progress, and rates performance through quality KPIs
Quality Program Development: Builds quality management program tracking defects, mitigating risks, standardizing root cause analysis, and implementing performance measures
Reporting and Stakeholder Communication: Creates standardized reporting for MFP&A; delivers regular deployment progress updates to management and stakeholders
Network Plan Tracking: Manages approved network plans with internal customers and construction vendors through to in-service delivery
Cross-Functional Program Management: Simultaneously manages multiple competing projects/programs, some at global scale
Daily Collaboration: Interfaces with engineers, technicians, vendors, and senior management
Physical Audits: Audits completed construction, reviews fiber test results, and hands off deliverables to internal customers
Risk and Escalation Management: Anticipates bottlenecks, manages risk/escalations, and balances business needs vs. technical constraints
Site Access Coordination: Coordinates access and approvals for security-regulated sites

A day in the life

This role oversees deployment of infrastructure, and iterative procedural changes. This includes travel to the field, generation of weekly reports, and updating standards and specifications for a global deployment team. This position requires onsite visits to physical locations and is not a full time remote job. Physical inspections and learning the technical standards for outside and inside fiber plant is required.

About The Team

The Global Connectivity Infrastructure Delivery - Fiber Deployment (GCID-FD) team is responsible for planning, managing, and delivering physical fiber optic network infrastructure across North and South America. The team partners with construction vendors, engineers, and internal stakeholders to deploy large-scale fiber networks on time and to the highest quality standards. Through rigorous vendor management, quality control programs, and cross-functional collaboration, GCID-FD ensures network infrastructure moves from approved plans to in-service delivery. The team drives network strategy, manages risk, and coordinates complex deployments across security-regulated sites to support global connectivity goals.

Knowledge of best practices and emerging technologies, related to infrastructure (i.e. network, data center, hardware, software)
Experience with varying scenarios of infrastructure builds
You must have 3+ years experience managing third-party construction or infrastructure vendors, including tracking delivery timelines, measuring performance through KPIs, and implementing corrective actions when quality standards.
You must have 3+ years experience auditing completed construction, reviewing fiber test results or similar deliverables, and coordinating site access in security-regulated environments.
You must have 3+ years experience proactively identifying deployment bottlenecks, managing escalations, and balancing business needs against technical constraints to keep projects on track.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working in a network planning, network construction/implementation, or commercial implementation role at an ISP, telecoms operator, or Hyperscaler

About Us

Zeitview is the leading intelligent aerial imaging company for high-value infrastructure, providing businesses with actionable, real-time insights to recover revenue, reduce risk and improve build quality. We serve customers in the solar, wind, insurance, construction, real estate, and critical infrastructure industries. Trusted by the largest enterprises in the world, Zeitview is active in over 70 countries. Our mission is to accelerate the global transition to renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure through advanced inspection solutions. Take a look at our latest achievements here!

About The Role

We are seeking a Hardware Production Program Manager to own the end-to-end production planning, qualification, and lifecycle of our cutting-edge aerial sensors and robotic drone payloads.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex hardware design and flawless operational execution. You will run the programs behind New Product Introduction (NPI), repeat production builds, and sustain engineering support for our existing fleet - driving schedules, procurement, and cross-team coordination. If you are a natural problem solver who thrives in a fast-paced robotics environment and loves turning complex engineering prototypes into reliable, scalable products, we want to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Production Program Management & NPI
:

Own the hardware build ecosystem: Create and manage comprehensive NPI and repeat build timelines, ensuring procurement, staffing, tooling, and documentation are set up for success.
Balance the fleet: Align closely with Operations to understand hardware demand and field repair needs. Partner with the technicians and their functional leads to sequence work across new builds, repairs, and fleet movements.
Procurement ownership: Manage procurement pipelines and BOMs, and execute procurement with vendors for a majority of sourced components.
Production leadership: Hire and develop staffing required to meet production and sustainment volumes. Develop and leverage external vendors for production when commercially reasonable.
Schedule and risk ownership: Maintain the single source of truth for build status, dependencies, and risk. Escalate early and clearly when timelines are threatened.

Sustaining Engineering & Cross-Functional Coordination

Technical conduit: Act as the primary technical bridge across engineering and operations teams to accelerate debugging and issue resolution.
Field support: Coordinate troubleshooting of complex issues occurring in the field; ensure clear ownership is assigned and root-cause resolutions are documented.
Process scaling: Scope and implement critical process improvements for part tracking, unit history, and issue tracking as our hardware scales.
System Performance Management: Track issues across hardware fleet under support to identify common issues and develop solutions to implement in the field to reduce excessive costs and improve system performance.
Blocker mitigation: Anticipate production or field blockers early and implement creative, agile engineering solutions to keep timelines on track.

Qualifications
:.

Experience: 5+ years in engineering, product development, hardware program management, or hardware manufacturing, with a strong preference for complex robotic, aerospace, or drone platforms.
Program leadership: Proven track record driving hardware programs to completion through influence rather than direct authority - coordinating technicians, engineers, and vendors toward a shared schedule.
Technical breadth: A deep understanding of electro-mechanical assemblies, aerial sensors, and payload integration, allowing you to assess field issues and dive deep into root-cause analysis when required.
Execution & agility: The ability to ruthlessly prioritize competing demands, manage tight timelines with many moving pieces, and creatively fill operational gaps.

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager – Solutions Engineering to help transform complex creative, operational, and business needs into clear, scalable technology solutions.

You will lead the early stages of complex initiatives by understanding stakeholder challenges, defining the underlying business problem, developing clear requirements, and helping determine the best path forward.

jobs.title: Senior Strategic Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Kestra Financial is a wealth management platform dedicated to empowering independent financial professionals—including traditional and hybrid RIAs—to grow their businesses and deliver exceptional client service. We combine advanced business management technology with personalized consulting to provide unmatched scale, efficiency, and support. Our advisor-focused culture is built on innovation and advocacy, enabling advisors to offer comprehensive securities and investment advisory solutions to their clients

Lead with Purpose. Partner with Impact

Kestra Financial, a leading provider of wealth management platforms, technology solutions, and investment products empowering independent financial advisors and RIAs nationwide, is seeking a Senior Strategic Implementation Manager.

This role serves as a pivotal execution leader accountable for the disciplined delivery of Kestra Wealth Management’s highest-priority strategic initiatives in investment products and platform capabilities. You will drive the successful launch of new investment products and manage end-to-end launch campaigns while coordinating complex cross-functional projects spanning technology, compliance, business development, and operations.

By implementing and championing agile, Scrum-like cadences and robust portfolio governance practices, you will build transparency, predictability, and accountability across initiatives. Your leadership will ensure that strategic intent translates into measurable business outcomes—including accelerated advisor adoption, revenue contribution from new products, enhanced platform capabilities, and operational excellence.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role for a collaborative leader who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, and cross-functional influence in a dynamic, growth-oriented wealth management environment.

What You’ll Do:

Own the end-to-end governance and planning that results in successful delivery of priority investment product launches (e.g., alternative investment solutions, insurance products, or curated offerings) and strategic platform implementation initiatives (new advisory revenue vertical, investment program redesign, etc) from concept through post-launch optimization and benefits realization.
Lead the coordination and execution of comprehensive launch campaigns, aligning go-to-market activities including sales enablement, marketing communications, advisor training and onboarding programs, distribution strategy, and adoption tracking to drive rapid uptake and sustained engagement.
Establish and maintain a prioritized portfolio of strategic initiatives for Investment Platforms & Products; drive rigorous sequencing, capacity alignment, funding discipline, and proactive trade-off decisions (scope, timeline, resources, investment) aligned to Kestra’s business objectives and growth priorities.
Partner with Product Management to translate product strategy and roadmap into executable implementation plans with clear milestones, dependencies, and success criteria.
Support Wealth Management platform and product leads by facilitating high-performing cross-functional project teams and workstreams involving:
Technology: Platform development, data integrations (including MDM/medallion architectures), APIs, advisor portals/tools, and infrastructure enhancements.
Compliance & Legal: Product due diligence, regulatory reviews/approvals, disclosures, risk assessments, and ongoing product governance to ensure adherence to SEC, FINRA, fiduciary, and other requirements.
Business: Commercialization strategy, RIA/advisor engagement and feedback loops, distribution channel readiness, pricing/packaging, and P&L impact modeling.
Operations & Finance: Operational readiness, process design, financial tracking, and benefits measurement.
Map and manage complex dependencies, risks, and interdependencies across teams; proactively identify and remove blockers while fostering alignment and shared ownership in a matrixed environment.
Ensure every initiative incorporates appropriate compliance guardrails, risk controls, audit readiness, and change management from the start.
Design, implement, and continuously mature agile delivery operating models tailored to regulated investment product and platform initiatives. This includes establishing Scrum-like cadences (sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, retrospectives), Kanban for workflow transparency and flow optimization, and scaled frameworks (e.g., program-level planning or release management) for larger or interdependent efforts.
Stand up consistent governance rhythms and forums, including steering committees, launch readiness reviews/tollgates, dependency management sessions, risk reviews, and clear escalation paths to executive leadership.
Drive adoption of modern agile/project tools (Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps, or equivalent) and best practices to improve delivery velocity, predictability, collaboration, and quality across technology and business teams.
Champion a shift toward iterative, outcome-focused delivery—balancing the need for structure and compliance in product launches with the speed and adaptability required in a competitive wealth tech landscape.
Build and operate a portfolio “control tower” capability: deliver timely, credible, decision-oriented reporting and dashboards on initiative status, milestones, risks/issues, dependencies, financial performance (budget vs. plan, ROI tracking), and leading indicators of business impact.
Define, track, and report on key business outcome metrics tied to each strategic initiative (e.g., new product net flows/AUM/revenue contribution, advisor adoption and usage rates, client/advisor satisfaction or NPS impact, reduction in time-to-market or launch cycle time, compliance adherence, platform feature utilization and engagement).
Proactively surface execution risks, capacity constraints, and recommended trade-offs to senior leadership; lead structured issue resolution, corrective action planning, and recovery efforts to protect delivery commitments and protect/enhance business results.
Prepare and present high-quality materials for executive leadership, steering committees, and governance forums; represent the delivery health and outlook of the Investment Platforms & Products portfolio with clarity and fact-based insights.
Instill a culture of genuine accountability—where teams own and are measured on the delivery of agreed business outcomes and value realization, not merely activity completion or milestone hitting.

What You Bring: 

Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or Software Engineering.
2+ years experience in technical product management in an Agile environment.
5+ years of experience in wealth management, investment operations, or trading
3-5+ years of progressive leadership experience in strategic program/portfolio management, product implementation, launch execution, or enterprise transformation roles within wealth management, RIA platforms, investment product development, fintech, asset/wealth platforms, or similarly complex, regulated financial services environments.
Demonstrated success leading multiple end-to-end launches of investment products or major platform capabilities, including coordination across technology builds, compliance/regulatory approvals, and go-to-market execution
Direct experience with alternatives/private markets access, model portfolios, structured solutions, or advisor-facing technology platforms within a broker dealer organization is strongly preferred.
Track record of successfully implementing or significantly maturing agile delivery practices (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, hybrid, or tailored approaches) in product development or regulated contexts, with quantifiable improvements in predictability, velocity, and time-to-value.

Certifications and Licenses:

Series 7 , 63 or 66 required within 2 years.
Series 65 preferred

Internal Application Policy:

Internal applicants must be in good standing and have a minimum of 1 year of service with Kestra. Internal applicants must also have a minimum of 1 year service in current role unless approved by EVP.

Benefits to support you:

Competitive pay and benefits with a large employer (over 1600 employees nationwide)
401(k), health insurance, and a competitive benefits package
Work in a supportive, collaborative environment committed to professional excellence
Help clients navigate meaningful financial decisions with confidence
Opportunities for training, development, and long-term growth within the firm
Tuition reimbursement for qualified expenses

Our Mission is Powering Financial Independence, enabling the growth and success of investing clients and the advisors who serve them. We do that by living our values: Serve, Make it Happen, and One team.

jobs.title: Healing to Advocacy Program Manager
jobs.description:
The Opportunity

Essie Justice Group (Essie) is building grassroots power to dismantle the US incarceration system, the most egregious creator of racial and gender injustice of our time. We are a loving and powerful community of women with incarcerated loved ones. Our community includes cisgender women, transgender women, formerly incarcerated women, gender expansive people, elders, and young people.

After twelve years of building an active membership across California and beyond, Essie is deepening its base-building and leadership development strategies with the 1 in 4 women with incarcerated loved ones to propel bold decarceration agendas across the nation. We seek to transform the criminal legal system and create a Black feminist future rooted in care, equity, community safety, and liberation.

The ideal candidate understands and believes passionately in people power and is deeply interested in the leadership development of the people most impacted by the systems we seek to change. The Healing to Advocacy Program Manager is a crucial leader within our organization, charged with managing staff and the day-to-day operations of Essie’s signature organizing program. The ideal candidate is a master project manager and executor who thoroughly enjoys implementing large and growing programs. The ideal candidate will also have an important role in recommending changes to the Healing to Advocacy Program and leading in implementing those changes. What the person in this role loves to do is make sure things happen and happen well. The ideal candidate can thoughtfully create work plans; delegate and support others in program implementation; bring out the best in staff, contractors, and members through strong management and people skills; and drive themselves and the staff they supervise towards goals.

Core Responsibilities

Manage Essie’s Healing To Advocacy Organizing Program

Management: Directly Manage 1-2 staff members and run the day-to-day operations of the Healing to Advocacy Program. Key functions include:
Logistics: Create a top-notch logistics plan to reduce barriers to participation. Solve complex logistical problems related to the different parts of the program and in response to the needs of members.
Childcare Program: Manage and co-design the EssieKids! Program, ensuring childcare needs are reasonably met within the Healing to Advocacy Program.
Contractor & Relationship Management: Manage contractors, including childcare providers, guest trainers, and other specialists. Hold external relationships necessary to run the overall program successfully.
Member Recruitment & Cohort Filling: Coordinate and oversee the implementation of a member recruitment strategy. Member recruitment involves thousands of nomination letters from incarcerated people, coordinating a nominations committee to make phone calls to the nominees, and filling dozens of member cohorts statewide.
Recruit and Manage Member Facilitators: Identify, onboard, and support member facilitators who co-lead program sessions and activities, ensuring they are trained and prepared to engage cohorts effectively.
Cohort Launch: Launch cohorts in 15-20 different locations across the state.
Cohort Graduations: Coordinate a team of staff and members to ensure that 2-4 Healing to Advocacy Graduation events occur per year that graduate multiple cohorts each and officially welcome cohort participants into Essie’s advocacy body and membership.
Evaluation: Manage data and administration goals during all parts of the program.

Member Training & Support

Coordinate the multi-day agenda and facilitate the Essie Facilitator Training Retreats to prepare Essie members to run cohorts in their areas.
Respond in a culture and values-aligned manner to needs, concerns, and recommendations from Healing to Advocacy Facilitators and program participants.
Track and share the leadership development outcomes with the Directors’ Team through strategic data collection, presentation of information, and uplifting actionable recommendations.

Team Leadership

Ensure the program is meeting its stated goals as set by the and the collaboratively created Operational Plan;co-designing and implementing a program evaluation system.
Proactively provide input on programmatic improvements.
Manage and train staff and contractors who are carrying out core functions of the Healing to Advocacy Program (i.e. childcare, staff organizers, trainers, graphic designers) to achieve set organizational goals together.
Oversee member retention, recruitment, evaluation, and data management systems design related to the program.

Who We’re Looking For

Ideal Qualifications

3-5 years of experience in complex program implementation, preferably in community organizing or direct services contexts.
Detail-oriented project manager with experience managing multiple, complex projects at once.
Understands and demonstrates knowledge of best practices in recruitment, retention, and Black feminist culture-setting.
Excellent prioritization skills (i.e. understands the difference between what’s important, urgent, and what is neither).
Advanced experience in facilitating retreats, workshops, and/or political education trainings.
Experience supervising people in a way that acknowledges differentials in privilege and power, recognizes their gifts, encourages their confidence, supports their growth, and holds them accountable to standards and achieving collective goals.
Effective writing, editing, and verbal communication skills.
Track record as a collaborative leader.

Qualities

Program manager extraordinaire. You believe in the power of an excellently designed and run program as a key avenue for social and personal change. You build air-tight plans, through your skill as an “if, then” thinker, mitigating risks of a plan failing by imagining and preparing for various scenarios, smart prioritization, and advance problem-solving. If things go wrong or when faced with an unforeseen complexity you draw on your professional experience and flexibility to come up with possibilities and motivate others.
You’re very into root causes. You think about programmatic challenges from a big picture lens, wondering if what you observe is a symptom of a broader problem, and identifying possible patterns and system-based solutions to address it.
Discernment and honesty we can trust. You are a thoughtful team member who acts in alignment with your integrity and are unfailingly trustworthy.
Committed to evolution. You are committed to continuously deepening and evolving your own understanding of systems of oppression through study, openness, and humility. And, you easily recognize your own relationship to privilege and power, examining and shifting your behaviors as appropriate.
Uplifting and additive. You see mistakes as opportunities for growth; problems as catalysts for solutions, and inspire others along difficult journeys. You carry a positive approach, can-do attitude, a sense of humor, and authentic kindness wherever you go. You can lead from an authentic and calm place to help others feel confident, assured and hopeful that possibilities exist in the face of challenge or uncertainty.

The Position

The Healing to Advocacy Program Manager is a full-time, salaried, exempt position. This position leads the Healing to Advocacy Program and reports to the Associate Director of Strategy & Organizational Impact. The salary for this position is between $90,000 - $95,000 depending on experience, with full medical, dental, and vision benefits, optional 401(k), a substantial vacation package, and a monthly personal wellness stipend. The position can be based at either of Essie’s offices in Los Angeles or Oakland, California.

To Apply

Please address a personal, specific, and thoughtful cover letter to the “Essie Hiring Committee” and submit along with a resume through our hiring portal (https://essiejusticegroup.bamboohr.com/jobs). Your resume tells us what you can do; your cover letter should tell us who you are and why you want to work with Essie.

Essie Justice Group provides equal employment and advancement opportunities to all staff members. Employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and skills. Essie does not discriminate in employment opportunities or practices on the basis of race, color, creed, religion, national origin, immigration status, socioeconomic status, ancestry, age, size, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, familial status, veteran status, disability, AIDS/HIV status, medical condition, prior conviction, arrest history, traits historically associated with race, including, but not limited to, hair texture and protective hairstyles, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Essie values and specifically seeks applicants who are people with incarcerated loved ones; formerly incarcerated people; people of color; women; queer, transgender, gender expansive, and gender fluid people.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, performance assessment, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

About Essie Justice Group

Essie Justice Group is a non profit organization of women with incarcerated loved ones taking on the rampant injustices created by mass incarceration. Our award-winning Healing to Advocacy Model brings women together to heal, build collective power, and drive social change. Essie is

Great Place to Work-Certified™ by Great Place to Work.

Learn more at www.essiejusticegroup.org.

Description

Application deadline: Sep 18, 2026

Amazon is seeking an Engineering Program Manager to support the Amazon Logistics North America (AMZL NA) Engineering team, part of Amazon's Last Mile organization. The Last Mile team helps get customer packages from delivery stations to a customer's doorstep.

This is a unique opportunity to own high-impact engineering programs and mechanisms that advance the intelligence and reliability of our last mile business. We are looking for an individual who has experience creating scalable, data-driven solutions to complex reliability and engineering problems. In this role, you will be responsible for driving engineering program governance, compliance reporting, data analytics, and documentation systems that enable leadership visibility, cross-functional alignment, and operational excellence across a portfolio of automation and electrical infrastructure projects.

You will build and maintain the mechanisms that keep our engineering organization running at the highest standard—from automated dashboards and compliance reporting to documentation platforms and stakeholder coordination. You will partner with field engineers, electrical contractors, supply chain teams, and operations leaders to deliver scalable processes that reduce rework, improve quality, and accelerate project delivery.

Key competencies of this position include insisting on the highest standards in root cause quality and corrective action effectiveness; analyzing and deep diving systems performance; inventing and simplifying solutions that improve installation and operational processes; and providing technical expertise to internal customers and stakeholders.

Key job responsibilities

Design and maintain automated reporting pipelines and performance dashboards (e.g., equipment health trends, failure rates, system uptime) that provide leadership with real-time visibility into program health and enable data-driven decisions
Translate complex data sets into clear narratives and actionable recommendations for stakeholders at all levels, supporting weekly business reviews and program prioritization

Manage multiple concurrent engineering projects (electrical, automation, MHE) across the NA delivery station network, coordinating timelines and deliverables with external contractors
Track project milestones and completion metrics; identify process gaps through root cause analysis and implement corrective actions that reduce rework and accelerate project delivery
Own weekly organizational compliance reporting on a strict cadence; monitor metrics including training completion, invoice accuracy, and Correction of Error action item closure

Collaborate cross-functionally with Supply Chain, Startup Execution, Operations, RME, and external contractors; facilitate status meetings and manage escalations from field engineers through senior leadership

No two days look alike in this role. You will move fluidly between analyzing performance data and building dashboards, facilitating cross-functional alignment meetings, and designing scalable process improvements that eliminate rework across the network. You balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution—architecting a new reporting mechanism one hour and removing barriers for field teams the next. jobs.description:
Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

R&D Technical Project Manager-RF Chipsets

Overview

Keysight drives innovation in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees build world‑class solutions across communications, 5G/6G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets in more than 100 countries. Our award‑winning culture embraces bold ideas, technical rigor, and a passion for solving hard problems with industry‑first solutions. We believe belonging empowers people to innovate and thrive throughout their careers.

About The Job

This role leads the execution of the Labs technology portfolio that powers Keysight’s RF product roadmap—spanning MMICs, SiPs, and subsystems. You will run a single PLC across Labs technologies (NCI, NSI, Subsystems) from CON to SHP, giving leadership a clear view of investment, schedule, dependencies, and realized ROI into NPIs. You’ll align deliverables with Centers of Excellence (CoEs) and Solutions Groups, orchestrate fab priority with the Labs Materials Planner (in concert with PICO and PMTC), and drive resourcing tradeoffs with other TPMs and Technology Managers. You’ll partner with product and research leaders to capture future requirements, compare proposals to next‑best commercial alternatives, make data‑driven investment recommendations, and market Labs parts for maximal reuse and ROI across multiple product lines.

About The Team

You will join the Signal Conditioning and Subsystems
section in Keysight Labs. The team builds analog and mm‑wave front ends (ICs + modules)
for VNA platforms and frequency-domain applications, collaborating closely with CoEs and Industry Solutions Groups.

Responsibilities

Portfolio & PLC Governance (CON → SHP)

Run a single PLC across Labs technologies (NCI, NSI, Subsystems) that feed RF Instrument NPIs; maintain a unified, auditable view of scope, cost, schedule, risk, and benefits.
Define and track gate criteria and closure plans; ensure cross‑functional readiness for each PLC gate.
Maintain a concise executive dashboard highlighting status, deltas, critical risks, dependencies, and ROI realization.

Planning & Execution

Run regular project meetings (with IC, SIP and subsystem attendees together) and track progress from all contributors, raising and resolving any technical/non-technical issue appropriately
Align with CoEs on NCI/NSI/Subsystem deliverables (scope, schedule, acceptance criteria) tied to NPI milestones.
Sequence/coordinate fab runs and builds with the Labs Materials Planner; ensure end‑to‑end priority alignment with PICO and PMTC.
Manage integration plans for MMICs, SiPs, and subsystems into VNA architectures, including validation and qualification dependencies.

Resourcing, Risk & Dependency Management

Partner with Labs TPMs and Technology Managers to broker staffing tradeoffs and resolve bottlenecks.
Drive proactive risk identification/mitigation (supply, process, yield, packaging, test throughput, firmware dependencies).
Maintain what‑if scenarios for critical paths and long‑lead items (masks, substrates, specialized materials, fixtures).

Requirements & Roadmapping

Meet regularly with CoE and IST PMs/planners: capture future requirements (performance, cost, reliability, manufacturability) for ICs, SiPs, subsystems; translate into capability roadmaps.
Partner with design leads and architects to balance performance vs. cost vs. schedule; validate feasibility against fab and assembly/test constraints.

Stakeholder Communication

Provide regular program updates to Labs senior management, with sharp narratives and decision asks.
Keep customer/partner divisions synchronized on progress and risks.

Technical Context (RF/uW/mmW Focus)

Manage building blocks typical of RF front ends and frequency‑domain chains (e.g., mixers, LNAs/PAs, T/R modules, couplers/attenuators/switches, LO distribution, frequency extenders, calibration and metrology modules, multi‑chip SiPs, and integrated subsystems).
Ensure test strategies and DVT/qualification align with RF performance targets, including stability, linearity, noise, dynamic range, and calibration integrity.

What Success Looks Like (Examples of KPIs)

Predictable execution: forecast accuracy on schedule/cost; green trend on risk burndown.
Cycle‑time reduction for fab/build/test loops; improved yield/first‑pass success on critical MMICs/SiPs.
Stakeholder satisfaction: positive feedback from CoEs, Solutions Groups, and external customers (where applicable).

Qualifications

Core Qualifications

B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or related field with 5–10+ years of applicable experience in analog/mm‑wave ICs, SiPs, and related packaging/subsystem technologies.
1–5+ years in technical project/program management for new technologies and NPIs (or Team Lead roles with equivalent scope).
Strong communicator with a track record of instilling customer confidence and aligning diverse stakeholders.
Broad knowledge of electronic systems, especially high‑frequency analog/RF/mmWave and relevant subsystems.
General understanding of semiconductor foundry operations, including Keysight HFTC and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions, take initiative, drive to results, and collaborate in fast‑paced environments.

Desired Qualifications

Experience orchestrating fab priorities, materials planning, and E2E build/test flows for MMICs/SiPs/subsystems.
Familiarity with PLC gating, NPI governance, and tools such as Jira/Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, Power BI/Excel.
Background working with CoEs/Solutions Groups and external customers on requirements and productization.
Understanding of reliability/qualification considerations for RF/mmWave components and modules.

Location

Candidates must be local to Santa Rosa,CA or willing to relocate to Santa Rosa, CA.

About the Company

Titan Advanced Energy Solutions (Titan) is developing and commercializing software to enhance the quality of manufacturing processes in energy production industries worldwide. We have combined sophisticated AI algorithms, software engineering and ultrasound cell-inspection technology to improves the quality of the lithium-ion battery cell and other energy or manufacturing quality applications. These world-class technological advances benefit the whole value chain, resulting in increased daily usable charge capacity, longer battery life, and improved safety monitoring and control. Located in Salem, MA, Titan’s innovative strides have been recognized with numerous awards and funding from multi-national corporate investment groups, venture capital and top clean energy programs and institutions, including Greentown Labs, the Massachusetts Clean Energy Center (MassCEC) and the Department of Energy. Growing and poised to continue their positive momentum, this is an exciting time to join the Titan team!

About the Role

Titan is seeking a Technical Project / Program Manager to lead the execution of customer and product programs from initial definition through engineering, build, validation, deployment, and customer acceptance. This role sits within the Product organization and acts as the execution bridge between Product, Engineering, Software, Operations, Sales, and the customer. The successful candidate should have an engineering or technical background but does not need to be the senior technical authority on the program. The primary responsibility is to ensure that the right people are working on the right things, dependencies are understood, decisions are made, commitments are tracked, and programs move forward. This person must be highly organized, technically credible, comfortable working with engineers, and capable of bringing structure to a fast-moving environment without creating unnecessary process.

Responsibilities

Own project and program execution from kickoff through customer deployment and acceptance.
Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and critical paths.
Coordinate activities across Hardware Engineering, Software, Algorithms, Product, Operations, Manufacturing, Sales, and Customer Success.
Translate customer and product commitments into executable internal project plans.
Establish clear ownership of actions and deliverables.
Conduct regular program reviews focused on decisions, risks, dependencies, and actions.
Track engineering and operational resources across multiple customer programs.
Identify resource conflicts and escalate priority decisions when required.
Maintain program risk registers and drive mitigation activities.
Track customer requirements, contractual deliverables, FAT/SAT requirements, installation milestones, and acceptance criteria.
Coordinate prototype builds, factory acceptance testing, shipment, installation, commissioning, and customer acceptance.
Work closely with Engineering while allowing engineers to remain focused on technical execution.
Ensure changes in requirements, schedule, scope, or customer expectations are communicated across the organization.
Coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure decisions and actions are captured and closed.
Provide clear program-status reporting to Product leadership and executive management.
Help establish scalable but lightweight project-management processes as Titan grows.
Support multiple concurrent customer deployments and development programs.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline strongly preferred.
5–10 years of experience in technical project management, program management, engineering, or related roles.
Experience managing complex hardware, automation, industrial equipment, robotics, instrumentation, or other multidisciplinary engineering programs.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate multiple engineering disciplines and stakeholders.
Strong understanding of product-development and engineering lifecycles.
Experience managing schedules, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and customer deliverables.
Ability to understand technical discussions without needing to become the technical decision-maker.
Excellent organizational and follow-through skills.
Strong written and verbal communication.
Ability to communicate effectively with engineers, executives, suppliers, and customers.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities can change quickly.
Strong sense of ownership and accountability.

Industrial automation
Battery manufacturing or testing
Robotics
Automated manufacturing equipment
Automotive manufacturing
Semiconductor or high-volume manufacturing equipment
Instrumentation and test systems
Capital equipment
Factory installations and commissioning
Hardware/software integrated products
Customer-facing technical programs
Experience with common project-management and engineering tools such as Jira, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project, Monday.com, Confluence, ERP/MRP systems, or equivalent platforms is useful but not the primary qualification.
