Overview

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.

Our award-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.

Responsibilities

R&D Technical Project Manager-RF Chipsets

Overview

Keysight drives innovation in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~15,000 employees build world‑class solutions across communications, 5G/6G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets in more than 100 countries. Our award‑winning culture embraces bold ideas, technical rigor, and a passion for solving hard problems with industry‑first solutions. We believe belonging empowers people to innovate and thrive throughout their careers.

About The Job

This role leads the execution of the Labs technology portfolio that powers Keysight’s RF product roadmap—spanning MMICs, SiPs, and subsystems. You will run a single PLC across Labs technologies (NCI, NSI, Subsystems) from CON to SHP, giving leadership a clear view of investment, schedule, dependencies, and realized ROI into NPIs. You’ll align deliverables with Centers of Excellence (CoEs) and Solutions Groups, orchestrate fab priority with the Labs Materials Planner (in concert with PICO and PMTC), and drive resourcing tradeoffs with other TPMs and Technology Managers. You’ll partner with product and research leaders to capture future requirements, compare proposals to next‑best commercial alternatives, make data‑driven investment recommendations, and market Labs parts for maximal reuse and ROI across multiple product lines.

About The Team

You will join the Signal Conditioning and Subsystems
section in Keysight Labs. The team builds analog and mm‑wave front ends (ICs + modules)
for VNA platforms and frequency-domain applications, collaborating closely with CoEs and Industry Solutions Groups.

Responsibilities

Portfolio & PLC Governance (CON → SHP)

Run a single PLC across Labs technologies (NCI, NSI, Subsystems) that feed RF Instrument NPIs; maintain a unified, auditable view of scope, cost, schedule, risk, and benefits.
Define and track gate criteria and closure plans; ensure cross‑functional readiness for each PLC gate.
Maintain a concise executive dashboard highlighting status, deltas, critical risks, dependencies, and ROI realization.

Planning & Execution

Run regular project meetings (with IC, SIP and subsystem attendees together) and track progress from all contributors, raising and resolving any technical/non-technical issue appropriately
Align with CoEs on NCI/NSI/Subsystem deliverables (scope, schedule, acceptance criteria) tied to NPI milestones.
Sequence/coordinate fab runs and builds with the Labs Materials Planner; ensure end‑to‑end priority alignment with PICO and PMTC.
Manage integration plans for MMICs, SiPs, and subsystems into VNA architectures, including validation and qualification dependencies.

Resourcing, Risk & Dependency Management

Partner with Labs TPMs and Technology Managers to broker staffing tradeoffs and resolve bottlenecks.
Drive proactive risk identification/mitigation (supply, process, yield, packaging, test throughput, firmware dependencies).
Maintain what‑if scenarios for critical paths and long‑lead items (masks, substrates, specialized materials, fixtures).

Requirements & Roadmapping

Meet regularly with CoE and IST PMs/planners: capture future requirements (performance, cost, reliability, manufacturability) for ICs, SiPs, subsystems; translate into capability roadmaps.
Partner with design leads and architects to balance performance vs. cost vs. schedule; validate feasibility against fab and assembly/test constraints.

Stakeholder Communication

Provide regular program updates to Labs senior management, with sharp narratives and decision asks.
Keep customer/partner divisions synchronized on progress and risks.

Technical Context (RF/uW/mmW Focus)

Manage building blocks typical of RF front ends and frequency‑domain chains (e.g., mixers, LNAs/PAs, T/R modules, couplers/attenuators/switches, LO distribution, frequency extenders, calibration and metrology modules, multi‑chip SiPs, and integrated subsystems).
Ensure test strategies and DVT/qualification align with RF performance targets, including stability, linearity, noise, dynamic range, and calibration integrity.

What Success Looks Like (Examples of KPIs)

Predictable execution: forecast accuracy on schedule/cost; green trend on risk burndown.
Cycle‑time reduction for fab/build/test loops; improved yield/first‑pass success on critical MMICs/SiPs.
Stakeholder satisfaction: positive feedback from CoEs, Solutions Groups, and external customers (where applicable).

Qualifications

Core Qualifications

B.S./M.S./Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering or related field with 5–10+ years of applicable experience in analog/mm‑wave ICs, SiPs, and related packaging/subsystem technologies.
1–5+ years in technical project/program management for new technologies and NPIs (or Team Lead roles with equivalent scope).
Strong communicator with a track record of instilling customer confidence and aligning diverse stakeholders.
Broad knowledge of electronic systems, especially high‑frequency analog/RF/mmWave and relevant subsystems.
General understanding of semiconductor foundry operations, including Keysight HFTC and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to make decisions, take initiative, drive to results, and collaborate in fast‑paced environments.

Desired Qualifications

Experience orchestrating fab priorities, materials planning, and E2E build/test flows for MMICs/SiPs/subsystems.
Familiarity with PLC gating, NPI governance, and tools such as Jira/Confluence, MS Project/Smartsheet, Power BI/Excel.
Background working with CoEs/Solutions Groups and external customers on requirements and productization.
Understanding of reliability/qualification considerations for RF/mmWave components and modules.

Location

Candidates must be local to Santa Rosa,CA or willing to relocate to Santa Rosa, CA.

Careers Privacy Statement

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

Titan Advanced Energy Solutions (Titan) is developing and commercializing software to enhance the quality of manufacturing processes in energy production industries worldwide. Titan is seeking a Technical Project / Program Manager to lead the execution of customer and product programs from initial definition through engineering, build, validation, deployment, and customer acceptance. This role sits within the Product organization and acts as the execution bridge between Product, Engineering, Software, Operations, Sales, and the customer. The successful candidate should have an engineering or technical background but does not need to be the senior technical authority on the program. The primary responsibility is to ensure that the right people are working on the right things, dependencies are understood, decisions are made, commitments are tracked, and programs move forward. This person must be highly organized, technically credible, comfortable working with engineers, and capable of bringing structure to a fast-moving environment without creating unnecessary process.

Develop and maintain integrated project schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and critical paths.

Work closely with Engineering while allowing engineers to remain focused on technical execution.
Ensure changes in requirements, schedule, scope, or customer expectations are communicated across the organization.
Coordinate internal and external meetings and ensure decisions and actions are captured and closed.
Provide clear program-status reporting to Product leadership and executive management.
Help establish scalable but lightweight project-management processes as Titan grows.
Support multiple concurrent customer deployments and development programs.

Bachelor's degree in Engineering or another relevant technical discipline strongly preferred.
5–10 years of experience in technical project management, program management, engineering, or related roles.

Strong understanding of product-development and engineering lifecycles.
Experience managing schedules, dependencies, resources, budgets, risks, and customer deliverables.

At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Job Summary

The Operations Program Manager (OPM) is responsible for leading and managing all phases of customer programs from inception through production while ensuring alignment with business objectives, operational excellence, and customer expectations. The OPM owns the implementation and execution of the Product Lifecycle Commercial Management (PLCM) process at the site and serves as the site leader for Lean Manufacturing, Continuous Improvement, and Lean Six Sigma initiatives.

This position is accountable for program scope, cost, schedule, quality, and performance while driving cross-functional collaboration across EHS, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Quality, Finance, and Human Resources. The OPM leads efforts to improve operational performance, enhance customer satisfaction, reduce costs, develop organizational capabilities, and build a sustainable culture of continuous improvement.

The role is responsible for ensuring PLCM discipline, Lean transformation, and continuous improvement activities are integrated into daily operations and long-term strategic objectives.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Program and PLCM Leadership

Own and manage the site's PLCM process from quotation through end-of-life.
Lead cross-functional teams to ensure successful program launches, transfers, product changes, and lifecycle management activities.
Establish program milestones, schedules, budgets, and resource requirements.
Monitor program performance related to cost, quality, delivery, and customer satisfaction metrics.
Coordinate preparation of proposals, business plans, work statements, operating budgets, and customer deliverables.
Lead regular program reviews and business reviews with customers and internal leadership.
Identify program risks and develop mitigation plans to ensure successful program execution.
Serve as the primary communication interface between Operations, the Business unit, vendors, and internal teams regarding program performance and strategic initiatives.
Coordinate engineering, supply chain, manufacturing, quality, and operations activities to achieve program objectives.
Work closely with Business Unit and Operations leadership to identify opportunities for growth, operational improvements, and enhanced customer relationships.

Lean Manufacturing and Continuous Improvement Leadership

Serve as the site's subject matter expert for Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, and process excellence methodologies.

Operational Excellence and Performance Management

Maintain integrity and accuracy of site continuous improvement metrics and reporting systems.
Collaborate with Finance to validate project savings and integrate improvement results into business financial processes.
Develop and deploy systems that provide effective feedback loops, performance visibility, and accountability.
Identify and implement best practices across operations and share successful methodologies across the broader organization where applicable.
Lead cost reduction initiatives and develop long-term strategies that improve profitability while maintaining product quality and customer satisfaction.

Leadership and Organizational Development

Contribute to strategic planning and business execution.
Lead by example and model company values, servant leadership, accountability, and continuous improvement behaviors.
Foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, respect, learning, and innovation.
Provide coaching and mentoring to employees at all levels of the organization.
Partner with Human Resources to support leadership development, training programs, Lean certification pathways, and employee recognition initiatives.
Encourage cross-training, knowledge sharing, and workforce development to strengthen organizational capability and flexibility.
Build strong relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders to support long-term business success.

Safety, Compliance, and Risk Management

Support and champion all company safety, environmental, quality, and compliance initiatives.
Ensure Lean and operational improvement efforts maintain compliance with regulatory, customer, and company requirements.
Adhere to all company security, ethics, and confidentiality policies.
Comply with all safety and health regulations associated with the position.
Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

Job Qualifications

KNOWLEDGE REQUIREMENTS

Strong understanding of new product introduction (NPI), and manufacturing program management methodologies.
Demonstrated expertise in Lean Manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma, Industrial Engineering, and continuous improvement deployment.
Experience leading cross-functional teams within a matrixed manufacturing environment.
Strong business, financial, and operational acumen.
Experience with project management, change management, risk management, and strategic planning.
Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive organizational change.
Excellent leadership, facilitation, coaching, communication, and presentation skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, including statistical analysis and process control methods.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and manufacturing business systems.
Ability to read, analyze, and interpret engineering documents, operating procedures, financial reports, and customer requirements.

Education & Experience Requirements

Minimum of 5-8 years of experience in Manufacturing, Operations, Engineering, Program Management, Continuous Improvement, or related leadership roles.
Experience managing customer programs and cross-functional project teams in a manufacturing environment required.

Experience in change management and organizational development.

University degree in engineering or a related field.

Serves as the single point of contact (POC) for the Government and is responsible for overall contract performance and execution. This includes ensuring alignment with mission requirements and contractual objectives.

Experience supporting Department of State or similar federal facilities programs, demonstrating familiarity with mission requirements and operational expectations.

Experience managing KPI/AQL-driven performance contracts and supporting Quality Assurance Surveillance Plan (QASP) compliance.

Northland Controls is seeking an experienced QA/QC Project Manager to join our team supporting our project operations in Montgomery, Alabama. This is a great opportunity for an experienced project management professional who enjoys working closely with clients, coordinating complex security projects, and taking ownership of projects from planning through successful completion.

In this role, you'll manage projects throughout the full project lifecycle, including budgeting, planning, design coordination, scheduling, installation, financial performance, completion, and aftercare. You'll work closely with clients, internal teams, installation personnel, contractors, and other project stakeholders to keep work moving and ensure commitments are delivered.

If you're an organized, client-focused Project Manager who enjoys solving problems, coordinating teams, and keeping complex projects on track, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

Manage projects from initial planning and budgeting through execution, completion, and aftercare.
Develop and maintain strong relationships with client decision-makers, project stakeholders, and contracted partners.
Serve as a primary point of coordination for project activities and represent Northland Controls professionally in client and partner interactions.
Develop and maintain project plans, schedules, specifications, and supporting documentation.
Coordinate project design activities and ensure required information is communicated to the appropriate project stakeholders.
Develop and maintain construction schedules, coordinating Northland activities with clients, contractors, other trades, and project partners.
Maintain accurate records of project status, changes, material flow, schedules, and other project controls.
Prepare and communicate project status reports for internal and external stakeholders.
Manage project costs and monitor overall project financial performance.
Forecast future project costs and identify potential budget or schedule impacts.
Track project costs, invoicing, financial progress, and other key project performance measures.
Coordinate installation activities, internal resources, and contracted partners to support successful project delivery.
Identify project risks, issues, changes, and potential roadblocks and communicate them to the appropriate stakeholders.
Work collaboratively with project teams to resolve issues and keep projects progressing according to plan.
Support project closeout and aftercare activities to ensure client commitments are completed.

What We're Looking For

3+ years of project management experience, preferably supporting construction, security systems, technology integration, or a related environment.
Demonstrated experience managing projects from planning and budgeting through execution and completion.
Bachelor's degree in Construction Management, Engineering, Science, Technology, Mathematics, or a related field is preferred.
Strong understanding of project budgeting, cost management, forecasting, scheduling, and project controls.
Strong client-facing skills with the ability to build effective relationships with clients, contractors, and project stakeholders.
Excellent organizational, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and project requirements in a fast-paced environment.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative project team.
Ability to obtain the Security Industry Association's Certified Security Project Manager (CSPM) certification within the first six months of employment.
Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is preferred.
Ability to work in both office and active construction-site environments.
Ability to travel periodically or frequently based on project needs, which may be up to 50%.

Why Join Northland Controls?

At Northland Controls, you'll be part of a global team focused on delivering exceptional security solutions and service to our clients. As a QA/QC Project Manager, you'll have the opportunity to take ownership of complex project activities, work directly with clients and project teams, and play an important role in delivering successful security projects.

We value collaboration, accountability, continuous improvement, and people who are willing to take ownership, solve problems, and help projects succeed.

About Northland Controls

Northland is a world-class global security integrator with offices in the United States, United Kingdom, Singapore, China and India. We specialize in design, build, integration, and management of high-end Lenel, Software House, S2 global enterprise security systems which include 6 out of 10 of the largest hi-tech companies in Silicon Valley.

We are responsible for single card reader installations in some of the most remote parts of the world, all the way through to the design, deployment and management of large enterprise systems managing up to 300 corporate offices in over 70 countries including datacenters and multi-faceted security operations centers.

With 250 highly trained professionals, all program management, project management, system design, system programming, testing and commissioning is carried out by Northland Controls experts to ensure we deliver the right solution, to the right standard, every time, anywhere in the world. In addition, Northland is supported by a network of over 100 in-country local service partners (LSPs) across the world who partner with Northland to deliver unparalleled world class services to our enterprise customers.

We are trusted to get the job done no matter what. Through word-of-mouth our elite list of customers has rewarded us with phenomenal growth from $1M to $70M in 10 years’. To achieve this, we are always interested in the very best people who share our core values and beliefs and will “do whatever it takes” to enable our customers to realize their goals. We will take on difficult challenges regardless of where they may lead us, and we will always take the most honorable route to get there.

Our Mission

To be the most trusted and influential leader in the industry. By delivering exceptional services across the world, we are determined to continually surprise our customers, the industry and even ourselves while having fun.

Core Values

Be Honorable * Take on Challenges * Do Whatever it Takes * Our People * Have Fun

The incumbent will serve as an IT Business Analyst/Project Manager in the U.S. Department of State's (DOS) Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs (ECA) under the authority of the Fulbright-Hays Act of 1961 as amended and the Smith-Mundt Act of 1948. The position has two primary areas of responsibility: (1) fulfilling High Value Asset (HVA) compliance requirements for IVLP data, currently in the International Visitor Leadership Program Resource Center (IVRC) platform, and (2) conducting a comprehensive analysis and modernization of the office's current information systems and databases. Incumbent will serve under the direction of a Division/Branch Chief to support the IVLP mission and enhance operational efficiency.

The IT Business Analyst/Project Manager will serve in the Office of International Visitors and U.S. Speaker Program at the U.S. Department of State's Bureau of Educational and Cultural Affairs. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring compliance with federal HVA requirements and conducting comprehensive analysis and modernization of the office's information technology systems and databases.

The IT Business Analyst/Project Manager position is responsible for managing HVA compliance activities and conducting information systems analysis and modernization. The incumbent will have broad, independent responsibilities and authority to ensure successful fulfillment of all HVA requirements and provide strategic recommendations for technology improvements.

Job Duties:

HVA System Management and Compliance:

Provide updated high value asset (HVA) system information during quarterly and annual data calls as required by the Department's HVA Oversight Program
Ensure that the HVA Security Control Overlay for the IVRC system (or a subsequent platform) is implemented
Ensure that the IVRC system (or a subsequent platform) meets Department Continuous Diagnostics and Mitigation (CDM) requirements
Maintain ongoing authorization of the IVRC system (or a subsequent platform)
Coordinate and participate in annual penetration testing for the IVRC system (or a subsequent platform)
Participate in tri-annual HVA assessments as required by BOD 18-02

BOD 18-02 Data Call Management:

Collaborate with the HVA Oversight Team to successfully complete and submit all required data call responses

Update Point of Contact (POC) lists for all bureau HVA stakeholders on a quarterly basis and/or upon any role changes

HVA Assessment Coordination:

Coordinate with the HVA Oversight Team regarding assigned assessment quarters and scheduling for system assessments
Participate in HVA Assessment Kick-Off Meetings 15 days prior to the start of assessments
Gather, review, and provide HVA technical documentation as requested
Participate in all assessment meetings including Technical Exchange Meetings (TEMs), penetration testing activities, and out briefs
Respond to assessment artifacts and documentation requests in a timely manner

Vulnerability Remediation and Reporting:

Create POA&Ms in ArchAngel for all open HVA assessment findings
Develop and submit remediation plans for all high, major, and critical findings if full remediation cannot be completed within 30 days of the final assessment report
Ensure remediation plans are signed by bureau leadership
Provide remediation plan updates to the HVA Oversight Team every 30 days until findings have been remediated
Provide evidence of Independent Verification & Validation (IV&V) confirmation of finding remediation

FISMA Metrics Reporting:

Respond to quarterly Federal Information Security Modernization Act (FISMA) Data Calls to ensure the Department meets FISMA requirements for HVA systems
Provide accurate and timely responses to HVA-specific FISMA metrics 20-25 days before quarterly due dates
Respond to audit clarification questions and requests for additional information regarding FISMA metrics

Critical Software Management:

Ensure current system critical hardware and software are documented and maintained in ArchAngel
Ensure the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) is updated with the latest critical software at least quarterly
Ensure security tools are updated with system current assets at least quarterly or when major changes arise
Identify and inventory all critical software in use within the IVRC system
Manage supply chain risks, including maintaining a Software Bill of Materials (SBOM)

HVA Cybersecurity Dashboard Monitoring:

Notify appropriate POCs to resolve data issues prior to the end of each quarter
Submit update requests to data owners prior to quarterly cut-off dates for changes to be reflected in final quarterly scorecard reporting
Attend stakeholder information sessions as required
Respond to HVA and Extended Support License Data Calls

Current Systems Analysis:

Conduct comprehensive inventory and analysis of all information systems and databases currently used by the Office of International Visitors and U.S. Speaker Program
Document how current systems interact with each other, including data flows, integration points, and dependencies
Map business processes to existing technology solutions to identify gaps and inefficiencies
Analyze user workflows and identify pain points in current system usage
Document technical architecture, including hardware, software, network configurations, and security controls

Needs Assessment and Strategic Recommendations:

Conduct interviews with program officers, branch and division chiefs, and other OIV staff to understand business requirements
Identify challenges and limitations of the current system setup
Evaluate data management practices, including data quality, accessibility, and security
Analyze reporting capabilities and identify gaps in business intelligence and analytics
Develop comprehensive needs assessment report documenting findings and recommendations
Identify key requirements and capabilities the office should prioritize when modernizing current systems
Develop roadmap for system modernization initiatives

Stakeholder Engagement:

Collaborate with relevant Department of State IT offices, including the Bureau of Diplomatic Technology (DT)
Coordinate with external stakeholders including National Program Agencies and Community Based Members as needed

Documentation and Reporting:

Prepare detailed technical documentation of current systems and modernization plan
Create visual diagrams and flowcharts to illustrate system architectures and processes
Develop user guides and training materials as needed
Prepare oral and written reports on systems analysis findings and recommendations
Maintain project documentation in accordance with Department standards

Future System Development Support:

Develop detailed functional and technical requirements documents
Create user stories and use cases to support system design
Work with software developers and vendors to implement new systems
Conduct user acceptance testing and quality assurance activities
Develop implementation and change management plans
Provide training and support during system transitions

Requirements

A minimum of three (3) years of professional work experience in IT project management, business analysis, cybersecurity compliance, or related field

Experience with business process analysis, requirements gathering, and IT modernization

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines
Experience working with databases and information systems

Description

McCallie Associates, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of Alutiiq, LLC, is accepting applications for a Senior Program / Operations Manager to lead contractor support for one of the U.S. Space Force's most strategically important mission areas: missile warning, tracking, and defense. You will sit at Space Systems Command's Space Sensing directorate at Los Angeles AFB, leading a multi-disciplinary team of aerospace, electrical, electronics, and industrial engineers supporting the acquisition, development, and sustainment of next-generation missile warning satellite and ground systems — including Next-Generation Overhead Persistent Infrared (Next-Gen OPIR) and modernization of Space Based Infrared System (SBIRS) capabilities.

This is the senior contractor leadership position on the mission area and will be the day-to-day face of the contractor team to the Government Mission Director, the integrator across 30+ engineers and analysts, and the accountable manager for performance, cost, schedule, and personnel decisions. The mission is operationally significant: the systems your team supports are how the United States detects, tracks, and characterizes ballistic missile and hypersonic threats globally, in real time, 24/7.

Lead the contractor team supporting a Space Force missile warning mission area; integrate engineering, operations, cybersecurity, and acquisition support across multiple satellite and ground programs
Serve as the senior contractor point of contact for the Government Mission Director, Division Chief, Contracting Officer's Representative (COR), and Contracting Officer
Manage workforce assignment, surge support, leave coverage, and personnel substitutions; maintain workforce stability and minimize turnover impact
Participate in and lead Government program reviews, technical interchange meetings, integrated product team (IPT) sessions, and working groups
Provide senior input to Space Force planning and budgeting cycles, including Program Objective Memorandum (POM) exercises, annual POM updates, execution and spend plan reviews, and out-year funding profile development
Optimize cross-program resource use — direct functional experts across multiple missile warning programs to maximize cost, schedule, and performance efficiency
Forecast, manage, and control task order costs including travel, ODCs, and labor utilization
Oversee preparation and quality of monthly status reports, trip reports, and the data accession list; lead corrective action on any non-conforming deliverables
Manage subcontractor relationships and work distribution; ensure no organizational conflicts of interest; enforce non-disclosure agreements
Verify all team personnel maintain required clearances, CAC access, and information system compliance
Lead phase-in transition and onboarding for the mission area; execute weekly transition reviews during the first three months of performance

Requirements

Active Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility at start of employment
U.S. Citizenship
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Administration, Program Management, or a closely related discipline from an accredited institution
Minimum 10 years of progressively responsible experience managing or leading Department of Defense or Intelligence Community space, missile, or sensor system programs, with at least 5 years in a contractor program management, deputy PM, IPT lead, mission area manager, or equivalent senior leadership role on a DoD professional services or SETA contract
Direct programmatic, engineering, or operational experience with at least one of: missile warning satellite systems (DSP, SBIRS, Next-Gen OPIR); missile tracking and defense systems; overhead persistent infrared (OPIR) sensors; or strategic/tactical missile warning ground systems
Demonstrated experience managing teams of 20+ technical personnel under firm-fixed-price, time-and-materials, or cost-plus-fixed-fee contract structures

Strong written and verbal communication, including comfort briefing general officers, Senior Executive Service civilians, and senior contracting officials

Experience supporting OASIS+, GSA Schedule, or other IDIQ task order management

Capgemini Engineering

At Capgemini Engineering, the world leader in engineering services, we bring together a global team of engineers, scientists, and architects to help the world’s most innovative companies unleash their potential. From autonomous cars to to solutions against wildfires, our digital and software technology experts think outside the box as they provide unique R&D and engineering services across all industries. Join us for a career full of opportunities. Where you can make a difference. Where no two days are the same.

What you’ll be working on as Project Manager - Industrial Automation

As a Project Manager within the client's automation department, you will take ownership of the end-to-end delivery of automation projects in a highly regulated pharmaceutical environment. You will lead a diverse team of approximately 30 professionals, working across Bioreactors, Utilities, and Building Management Systems, leveraging automation platforms including Siemens PLC, Emerson DeltaV, and Honeywell HC-900. In this role you will play a key role in:

Leading project delivery end-to-end – Planning, executing, monitoring, and closing automation projects within scope, time, and budget, ensuring alignment with both client expectations and Capgemini Engineering's quality standards.
Stakeholder management & communication – Acting as the primary point of contact between the client's automation department, internal Capgemini Engineering teams, and third-party contractors, ensuring clear, consistent, and transparent communication across all levels.
Risk & issue management – Proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating project risks and issues, developing contingency plans to keep projects on track in a complex, regulated industrial environment.
Driving GMP compliance – Ensuring all project activities are carried out in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) guidelines and applicable pharmaceutical industry regulations, supporting validation and qualification activities where required.
Team coordination & leadership – Coordinating and motivating a cross-functional team of engineers and specialists, fostering a collaborative and high-performing project culture while managing workload distribution and resource planning.

Your profile

We are looking for a seasoned Project Manager with a strong technical background and a passion for delivering results in complex, regulated environments. You bring both the leadership skills to guide diverse teams and the technical credibility to earn the trust of engineers and specialists. You bring:

Proven project management expertise – Professional experience in technical environments, with at least 3 years in a dedicated Project Management role, and a recognised PM certification such as PMP or equivalent.
Industrial automation knowledge – A solid understanding of industrial automation systems and environments, with familiarity with platforms such as Siemens PLC, Emerson DeltaV, or Honeywell HC-900 being a strong advantage.
Pharmaceutical or GMP experience – Experience working in a regulated industry, ideally pharmaceuticals or life sciences, with working knowledge of GMP requirements and their implications for project delivery.
Strong leadership & stakeholder skills – Demonstrated ability to lead and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, manage diverse stakeholders, and communicate effectively at all levels of an organisation, from engineers to senior client management.

What We Offer

A gross salary between €3.500 and €5.500 per month, plus a mobility allowance of €850 and 8% holiday allowance (based on a 40-hour workweek).
26 vacation days. Looking for even more time off? You can purchase additional leave days.
Engagement in projects that directly impact industrial technology and innovation, where you can collaborate with top engineers and expand your expertise.
Access to career development programs, certifications, and digital learning platforms to support your growth.
Contributions to your pension, and you also have the flexibility to make additional personal contributions.
Work from wherever suits you best with our connectivity and home office allowance.
A high-performance laptop and a SIM card that you may also use for personal purposes.
FlexAbroad: Work up to 45 days per year from abroad.
A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.

Your work environment

With over 200 colleagues, our Manufacturing & Industrial Operations department offers significant and meaningful contributions to various organisations in The Netherlands and occasionally abroad. Our people have expertise in offering partnerships and solutions around industrial automation, smart factory, and data science. Our projects vary tremendously, from upgrading automation systems for a vaccin production line, designing smart sensors based on IoT and cloud technology to reduce food waste, to developing predictive models to optimize warehouse logistics. And sometimes you are working as technical coordinator in large project teams of over 50 colleagues, and at other times you are working on a solution with only two or three other colleagues. This makes our work highly unpredictable in scope, project duration and commuting time. Yet also incredibly rewarding in terms of learning and growth opportunities. And the best thing is, everyone has your back in becoming successful. Because our clients, our partners, depend on it!

new_jobs.title: Innovation Strategy & Research Analyst
new_jobs.description:
The Innovation Strategy & Research Analyst will work closely with the Vice President of R&D to connect PCCA’s scientific and technical capabilities with market opportunities, customer needs, and commercialization strategy.

This role will help identify and evaluate new opportunities, translate market and industry insights into actionable business recommendations, support development of business cases, evaluate potential partnerships and investments, and help guide R&D innovations from early concept through commercialization and post-launch learning.

The position serves as a strategic connection point between R&D and key functions including Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Clinical, Regulatory, and other areas of the organization.

The overall objective is to help PCCA identify the right opportunities earlier, make better investment decisions, and reduce the risk of developing technically strong innovations that do not translate into meaningful customer or commercial value.

What You Will Do

Market & Opportunity Discovery

Conduct primary and secondary research to identify emerging market trends, technologies, customer needs, competitive activity, regulatory changes, startups, and new business models.
Identify emerging opportunities and disruptions that may be relevant to PCCA.
Evaluate customer problems, unmet needs, current alternatives, and market gaps.
Translate complex market and technical information into clear business implications and recommendations for leadership.

Innovation Strategy & Opportunity Development

Work with R&D leadership to translate market needs and customer problems into potential products, services, technologies, or new business opportunities.
Explore different strategic approaches including build, partner, license, acquire, or invest.
Support development and prioritization of innovation opportunities based on customer value, competitive advantage, strategic fit, technical feasibility, and business potential.
Facilitate cross-functional ideation and strategic discussions around new opportunities.

Business Case Development

Develop and support business cases for new products, services, technologies, partnerships, and business models.
Assess market size, customer segments, competitive landscape, pricing considerations, development requirements, investment needs, timeline, risk, and expected return.
Partner with R&D and commercial teams to determine whether opportunities should advance, be modified, partnered, or discontinued.

R&D Commercialization Strategy

Help ensure R&D development programs remain connected to the original customer and market need throughout development.
Support customer research, concept testing, prototype validation, and feedback gathering.
Translate customer and market feedback into recommendations for product refinement and commercialization.
Work cross-functionally to help define target customers, positioning, value proposition, pricing considerations, channel strategy, and launch priorities.
Support commercialization readiness while maintaining clear ownership between R&D, Marketing, Sales, Business Development, Regulatory, and other functions.

Strategic Partnerships & New Business

Evaluate potential technology partners, startups, licensing opportunities, and strategic collaborations.
Support due diligence and strategic assessment of potential investments or partnerships.
Help determine whether PCCA should internally develop a capability or access it through partnership, licensing, investment, or acquisition.
Support incubation of new business platforms originating from R&D, including development of business models and commercialization pathways.

Post-Launch Learning

Evaluate product adoption, customer feedback, competitive response, customer segments, repeat usage, and other market signals after launch.
Identify opportunities for improvement, expansion, repositioning, or future development.
Translate post-launch learning into recommendations for the R&D pipeline and future innovation priorities.

Cross-Functional Leadership

Serve as a strategic bridge between R&D and other key business functions.
Facilitate cross-functional discussions and workshops to align teams around opportunities, concepts, business cases, and commercialization strategies.
Help prevent market intelligence, customer insights, technical knowledge, and business opportunities from becoming disconnected across functions.
Develop tools, frameworks, and repeatable processes that improve opportunity evaluation, innovation prioritization, and commercialization.

Who You Are

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Strategy, Innovation, Marketing, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field; advanced degree preferred.
Approximately 7+ years of experience in strategy, innovation, commercialization, market research, consulting, product strategy, or related functions.
Experience evaluating new markets, technologies, products, business models, or strategic growth opportunities.
Strong experience translating complex research and information into actionable strategic recommendations.
Experience working across multiple functions and influencing teams without direct authority.
Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, early-stage opportunities.
Experience developing business cases, market assessments, competitive analyses, and strategic recommendations.
Healthcare, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, compounding, medical technology, or related industry experience is preferred but not required.

Key Competencies

Strategic thinking
Innovation strategy
Market intelligence
Opportunity identification and prioritization
Commercialization strategy
Business case development
Customer and market research
Competitive analysis
Strategic partnerships
Cross-functional leadership
Executive communication
Structured problem solving
Ability to challenge assumptions constructively
Comfort working with technical and scientific teams

Arthrex is a global medical device company and a leader in new product development and medical education in orthopedics. Employees are part of a collaborative culture that values growth, quality, and continuous improvement. With strong career development opportunities, cutting-edge technology, and a mission that truly makes a difference for patients around the world, Arthrex offers the chance to build a meaningful and rewarding career.

The Business Intelligence Analyst Lead - LATAM serves as a strategic business partner to regional leadership, driving data-informed decision-making and commercial excellence across the Latin American region. The role is responsible for transforming complex internal, market, customer, and commercial data into actionable insights, predictive intelligence, and strategic recommendations that accelerate revenue growth, improve profitability, optimize pricing and sales performance, and support market expansion initiatives.

Leveraging advanced analytics, data science, AI-driven solutions, and business intelligence tools, the position provides a forward-looking view of business performance by identifying emerging trends, growth opportunities, competitive threats, market dynamics, and operational risks. The role develops predictive models, scenario analyses, and performance frameworks that support strategic planning, resource allocation, portfolio management, and commercial execution across diverse LATAM markets.

As a catalyst for commercial transformation, the Business Intelligence Analyst Lead enables leaders to move beyond descriptive reporting toward proactive and predictive decision-making. By integrating data storytelling with strategic business acumen, the role influences key decisions related to market share growth, customer engagement, pricing strategy, sales force effectiveness, and long-term business expansion, helping shape the future direction and competitive advantage of the organization across Latin America.

I f you're looking to work and thrive in a collaborative, high-performing culture, we invite you to join our talented team and help us fulfill our mission of Helping Surgeons Treat Their Patients Better™.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Analytics & Data Science Responsibilities

Lead the development of advanced business intelligence ecosystems integrating ERP, CRM, market intelligence, financial, and commercial datasets.
Develop predictive and prescriptive analytics models to forecast revenue, pricing behavior, customer adoption, and commercial performance.
Utilize machine learning, AI tools, and statistical modeling to anticipate business risks and opportunities.
Design executive dashboards with real-time visibility into ASP evolution, market share, account penetration, and Salesforce effectiveness.
Drive segmentation strategies across premium, mid-tier, and public markets to optimize portfolio positioning.
Identify surgeon adoption curves, purchasing patterns, and regional growth opportunities.
Monitor competitor activities, reimbursement trends, tender dynamics, and emerging technologies.
Lead data governance initiatives ensuring data quality, consistency, scalability, and accessibility.

Strategic Impact & Growth Responsibilities

Transform complex datasets into compelling executive-level business narratives.
Provide forward-looking insights that influence portfolio optimization and market expansion.
Identify growth acceleration opportunities through upselling, cross-selling, and pricing optimization.
Build predictive business models supporting long-range strategic planning and forecasting.
Deliver recommendations that directly impact revenue growth, profitability, and operational efficiency.

Leadership & Collaboration Responsibilities

Lead and develop a high-performing BI and Data Science team.
Promote a culture of innovation, accountability, and data-driven decision-making.
Act as a trusted advisor to senior leadership with proactive strategic recommendations.
Champion the adoption of AI, automation, and predictive analytics capabilities within LATAM.
Train and mentor commercial teams to improve data literacy and analytical capabilities.

Advanced Functional Competencies

Strategic Business Intelligence and executive-level decision support.
Predictive Analytics & Forecasting for future trend anticipation.
Machine Learning & AI Integration to optimize commercial performance.
Commercial & Financial Acumen with deep understanding of healthcare markets.
Data Storytelling & Executive Communication capabilities.
Change Leadership through data-backed insights and business transformation.
Innovation Mindset focused on automation and continuous improvement.

Functional Competencies

Business acumen: understands the business models, KPIS and industry benchmarks.
Data Interpretation & Analysis: Demonstrates proficiency in analyzing complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies that impact commercial performance, including ASP fluctuations, sales volumes, and market dynamics.
Insight Generation: Translates raw data into actionable insights that inform business strategies, such as identifying untapped market opportunities, optimizing upselling and cross-selling tactics, and improving surgery conversion rates.
Visualization & Storytelling: Develops clear, compelling dashboards and visual reports using BI tools to communicate findings effectively to stakeholders across LATAM.
Data-Driven Decision Making: Applies analytical thinking to support strategic initiatives, ensuring decisions are backed by evidence and aligned with business goals.
Collaboration & Influence: Works cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Finance Commercial teams to embed data literacy into daily operations and foster a culture of informed decision-making.

Education And Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, or related analytical field required.
Master’s degree in Data Science, Analytics, MBA, Artificial Intelligence, or related field strongly preferred.
8+ years of experience in Business Intelligence, Data Science, Commercial Analytics, or Strategic Analytics leadership.
Advanced expertise in Power BI, Tableau, SQL, Python, R, Power Query, DAX, and data modeling.
Experience with predictive analytics, machine learning models, AI-driven forecasting, and statistical analysis.
Strong understanding of CRM, ERP, and healthcare/commercial data ecosystems.
Experience influencing executive-level decisions through analytics and strategic recommendations.
Fluent in English, Spanish or Portuguese.

Machine, Tools, And/or Equipment Skills

PC servers, workstations, and laptops. Telecommunication equipment, cell phones and smart phones. Microsoft and Apple environment. Work with standard current computer applications, such as word processing, spreadsheets, and databases. MS Office 365, SQL server, Oracle, Cloud Solutions, and partner software applications.

office
,
in Washington, DC

U.S. Citizen

Demonstrated knowledge of Federal regulations in regard to area of specific need.
Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

Demonstrated skilled in oral and written communication, sufficient to draft action and info memos, congressional testimony, press guidance and congressional and general correspondence;

new_jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst @ CERT (M/V/X)
new_jobs.description:
Werkomgeving

Het Centrum voor Cybersecurity België (CCB)
is de nationale autoriteit voor cyberveiligheid in België. Het CCB superviseert, coördineert en waakt over de toepassing van de Belgische cyberveiligheidsstrategie. Door optimale informatievoorziening kunnen bedrijven, de overheid, aanbieders van essentiële diensten en de bevolking zich gepast beschermen. Meer info: https://ccb.belgium.be/nl/organisatie

Het Federaal Cyber Emergency Response Team (CERT)
is de operationele dienst van het CCB. De dienst is verantwoordelijke voor het beheer van en de respons op cybersecurity-incidenten in België. CERT.be zet zich in om de digitale infrastructuur, netwerken en systemen van het land te beschermen tegen cyberdreigingen. Haar opdrachten omvatten het monitoren, helpen oplossen en voorkomen van veiligheidsincidenten in België. Medewerkers van CERT.be spelen een coördinerende en ondersteunende rol bij het oplossen van dergelijke incidenten. Ze volgen ook de ontwikkelingen op het gebied van cyberbeveiligingstechnologieën.

De medewerkers van CERT.be zijn verdeeld in drie operationele teams:

Digital Forensics and Incident Response
Dit team is verantwoordelijk voor de coördinatie van acties die gericht zijn op incidentenrespons en forensische analyse.

Technical Research
Het Technical Research-team van CERT.be richt zich op toegepast onderzoek zoals malware-analyse en kwetsbaarheidsdetectie.

CSOC & Security Solutions
Het CSOC (Cyber Security Operation Center) team is het nieuwste team binnen CERT.be. Het is verantwoordelijk voor de configuratie, het onderhoud en de monitoring van de beveiligingssystemen van de infrastructuren van CERT.be en bepaalde federale partneradministraties (met hun medewerking). Het is de eerste lijn van incidentmanagement voor deze administraties. Het team zoekt regelmatig naar bedreigingen (Threat Hunting), zowel intern als op de netwerken van onze partneradministraties.
Het Security Solutions-team is verantwoordelijk voor het beheer van de IT-infrastructuur van CERT.be en de ontwikkeling van interne applicaties.

De teams van CSOC & Security Solutions beoordelen ook de impact van nieuwe technologieën op de wereld van cyberbeveiliging en plannen de integratie ervan en de ontwikkeling van innovatieve oplossingen (bijvoorbeeld op het gebied van kunstmatige intelligentie).

De Cybersecurity
Analyst
maakt deel uit van het CSOC & Security Solutions-team .

Taakomschrijving

Je belangrijkste taak is het verzamelen, analyseren en delen van informatie met betrekking tot dreigingen, kwetsbaarheden en aanvallen op de informatie- en communicatiesystemen van CERT.be en haar federale overheidspartners.
Om deze opdracht te vervullen, voer je eerstelijnsanalyses uit van meldingen van beveiligingsincidenten en informatie die je ontvangt van interne bronnen (IDS, SIEM, EDR, enz...) en externe bronnen ( federaal Incident Respons Team, inlichtingendiensten, enz...).
Je voert Threat Hunting uit om nieuwe vormen van aanvallen en Advanced Persistent Threats te detecteren die gericht zijn op onze infrastruren of die van onze partners.
Je bent in staat om relevante informatie uit deze bronnen te halen, nauwkeurig te beschrijven in rapporten met actiepunten en door te verwijzen naar de juiste afdelingen en personen.
Je werkt met complexe IT-infrastructuren en leert cybersecurity-oplossingen op maat te ontwikkelen.
Je volgt het cyberdreigingslandschap en de technologische ontwikkelingen in de IT-sector op de voet en maakt samenvattingen en richtlijnen over de onderwerpen.
Je werkt af en toe samen met het DFIR-team aan nationale incidentrespons en forensische analyse.

Let op: Aangezien het CCB vertrouwelijke en gevoelige gegevens verwerkt, moet een veiligheidsmachtiging worden verkregen, waarvoor een screening zal gebeuren (Wet van 11 december 1998. - Wet betreffende classificatie en veiligheidsmachtiging).

Profielomschrijving:

Je bent in het bezit van een Master of Bachelor diploma in IT, of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
Je bent vertrouwd met de Microsoft Windows-architectuur.
Je hebt een gedegen kennis van hoe netwerktechnologieën werken.
Je hebt een goede kennis van Unix, Linux en/of een variant BSD/OSX/mobile.
Je hebt minstens basiskennis van Firewalls en andere beschermingstechnologieën.
Je hebt een basiskennis van log analyses.
Je bent een kritische denker, je bent nieuwsgierig en bereid om vragen te stellen over wat je hebt geleerd om vooruitgang te boeken.
Je weet hoe je moet samenwerken, je werkt als onderdeel van een groep terwijl je ook zelfstandig je eigen werk kunt opvolgen (afhankelijk van de opdracht).
Je bent in staat om vertrouwelijke of persoonlijke informatie discreet te behandelen.
Je bent bij voorkeur tweetalig (Nederlands, Frans) of je beschikt over voldoende kennis van het Frans om probleemloos deel te nemen aan vergaderingen met andere specialisten en/of vertegenwoordigers van de eindgebruikers.
Je hebt een grondige en vlotte kennis van het technisch Engels (essentieel).
Je hebt een duidelijke interesse in Cybersecurity in het algemeen.

Volgende elementen zijn een pluspunt :

Je hebt ervaring in een helpdesk- of een SOC- omgeving.
Je hebt kennis van een scripting taal zoals Python, Perl, PHP, …
Je hebt kennis van hoe Azure cloud omgevingen werken.
Je hebt ervaring met Vulnerability assessment.
Je hebt ervaring met Blue team tools : tcpdump/Wireshark, Splunk/Qradar, Cortex/Darktrace, Security Onion, ...
Je hebt ervaring met Red team tools : Nmap, Burpsuite/Nessus en/of Metasploit, ...
Je hebt een basiskennis van hoe artificiële intelligentie zoals neurale netwerken of machine learning werkt, of je hebt interesse in het onderwerp en bent bereid om hierover meer te leren.
Je hebt een sterk analytische geest, je kan verbanden leggen tussen beveiligingsincidenten en je bent in staat om heldere en begrijpelijke rapporten te schrijven.
Je bent communicatief vaardig en servicegericht.
Je bent stressbestendig en je kan je werk structureren en prioritiseren.

Veiligheidsmachtiging

Het verkrijgen van een veiligheidsmachtiging door de Nationale Veiligheidsoverheid (NVO) (in overeenstemming met de wet van 11 december 1998 betreffende de classificatie en veiligheidsmachtigingmachtigingen, de veiligheidsattesten en de veiligheidsadviezen), is een voorwaarde om deze functie te kunnen uitoefenen en te blijven uitoefenen.

Door bij het CCB te werken, stem je ermee in een veiligheidsverificatie en een veiligheidsonderzoek te ondergaan in overeenstemming met de wet van 11 december 1998 betreffende de classificatie en de veiligheidsmachtigingen, veiligheidsattesten en veiligheidsadviezen

Veiligheidsonderzoek :

Na je indiensttreding voert de Nationale Veiligheidsoverheid een veiligheidsonderzoek uit.
Na het veiligheidsonderzoek zal de veiligheidsinstantie een gemotiveerde beslissing nemen over het al dan niet toekennen van een veiligheidsmachtiging.
Je kan enkel in dienst blijven als je een veiligheidsmachtiging krijgt.
De veiligheidsinstantie kan de machtiging intrekken

Wij bieden

Onze federale overheid is volop aan het informatiseren: van cybersecurity-uitdagingen tot digitale communicatie, van netwerkverbeteringen ter ondersteuning van nieuwe manieren van werken tot complexe ontwikkelingsprojecten en optimalisatietrajecten van bestaande applicaties.

Wil je hieraan meewerken en zo een maatschappelijke meerwaarde creëren, terwijl je tegelijk werkt aan je persoonlijke ontwikkeling en maximale kansen krijgt om je ambities waar te maken? Dan bieden wij:

Een duidelijke missie in een stimulerende werkomgeving
Een zeer competitief salarispakket met een uitgebreide waaier aan extralegale voordelen, waaronder:
Hospitalisatieverzekering
Maaltijdcheques
Mobiliteitsvoordelen
Pensioenfonds

Daarnaast hechten we veel belang aan een gezonde balans tussen werk en privé, met telewerkmogelijkheden voor de meeste functies. Onze kantoren zijn bovendien zeer goed bereikbaar met het openbaar vervoer.

About Us:

DeSimone is a leading global structural engineering firm known for delivering innovative, high-performance design solutions across the built environment. Our team of engineers, designers, and technical experts collaborates on a diverse portfolio—from iconic high-rise buildings to complex, large-scale structures—shaping skylines and communities around the world. Why DeSimone?

At DeSimone Consulting Engineering, you’ll work alongside some of the world’s most brilliant engineering minds on projects that redefine skylines and push the boundaries of design and innovation. From iconic skyscrapers to cutting-edge structures, our global portfolio reflects a commitment to excellence and creativity.

We are a team that values growth, collaboration, and real impact—you won’t just be part of the work, you’ll help shape it. With strong mentorship, hands-on experience, and opportunities to advance, you’ll build a career as impressive as the projects you’re working on.

We offer a flexible, collaborative work environment along with a comprehensive benefits package—including medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance, and 401K —designed to support your well-being and long-term success.

At DeSimone, your contributions matter. You’ll be trusted with meaningful work, empowered to grow, and supported every step of the way.

Ready to build what’s next? Join us.

About the Role:

DeSimone is seeking an experienced Forensic Structural Project Manager to assist with complex forensic investigations, structural assessments, litigation support assignments, and repair design projects.   This role combines technical expertise, project leadership, client management, and business development responsibilities within a growing forensic engineering practice.  
The teammate will manage investigations involving structural failures, construction defects, property damage, code-related issues, catastrophic events, and other performance concerns affecting buildings and infrastructure. This individual will oversee multidisciplinary project teams, develop technically sound and defensible engineering opinions, and serve as a trusted advisor to attorneys, insurance carriers, property owners, developers, contractors, and public agencies.  
The position offers significant opportunities for leadership, expert witness development, client relationship management, and growth within the firm's forensic engineering practice.  
What You'll Do: 

Project Leadership & Client Management

Serve as Project Manager for forensic engineering assignments from proposal through project completion.
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, and deliverables.
Act as the primary point of contact for condition assessment projects
Develop and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional service and technical expertise.
Participate in business development initiatives, proposal preparation, fee development, and client presentations.
Identify opportunities for repeat business and expansion of client relationships.

Project Leadership & Client Management

Serve as Project Manager for forensic engineering assignments from proposal through project completion.
Manage project scope, schedules, budgets, staffing, and deliverables.
Act as the primary point of contact for condition assessment projects
Develop and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional service and technical expertise.
Participate in business development initiatives, proposal preparation, fee development, and client presentations.
Identify opportunities for repeat business and expansion of client relationships.

Forensic Investigation & Analysis

Assist in forensic investigations involving structural failures, construction defects, building distress, settlement, vibration concerns, material deterioration, and code-related issues.
Conduct and oversee on-site forensic assessments and investigations, including surveying and documenting observations, photography, sketching, non-destructive testing, measurements, and data collection.
Conduct engineering analysis, field observations, and research.
Organize and evaluate field data to facilitate engineering analysis and problem solving.
Conduct condition assessments and damage evaluations of commercial, residential, institutional, industrial, and mixed-use structures.
Evaluate damage resulting from hurricanes, floods, fires, explosions, vehicle impacts, construction incidents, and other catastrophic events.
Research historical backgrounds of structures, building materials, construction methods, technical specifications, and applicable building code requirements.

Structural Analysis & Repair Design

Perform and oversee engineering calculations, structural modeling, and structural analysis for existing and new structures.
Develop repair, rehabilitation, retrofit, and remediation solutions for damaged or deficient structural systems.
Review and approve engineering analyses, calculations, drawings, and reports prepared by project team members.
Prepare and review feasibility studies, repair recommendations, specifications, and cost opinions.
Work with building departments, owners, and stakeholders to determine repair directives and code compliance requirements.

Litigation Support & Expert Witness Services

Provide engineering support for litigation and insurance claims.
Review construction documents, contracts, specifications, expert reports, technical records, and claims documentation.
Prepare clear, concise, and defensible technical and investigative reports detailing observations, testing results, analyses, research findings, opinions, and recommendations.
Assist with expert witness preparation, depositions, mediation support, and trial preparation.
Develop toward serving as an expert witness for forensic engineering matters.
Present technical findings to attorneys, insurance representatives, clients, regulatory agencies, and other stakeholders.

Technical Leadership & Industry Engagement

Mentor and develop junior engineers and technical staff.
Perform technical peer reviews and quality assurance reviews.
Conduct research and develop technical topics for publication, presentations, and industry conferences.
Present at professional organizations, client seminars, and industry events.
Remain current with emerging forensic methodologies, building technologies, and applicable codes and standards.

Minimum (Required) Skills:

Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or related field required.
Professional Engineer (PE) license required.
Minimum 8 years of structural engineering experience with experience in forensic investigations, failure analysis, structural assessments, restoration, repair design, or litigation support.
Demonstrated project management experience including budgeting, scheduling, staffing, and client management.
Strong understanding of steel, concrete, masonry, timber, and other structural systems.
Experience performing structural modeling and analysis.
Experience evaluating, repairing, and restoring diverse building types and structural materials.
Knowledge of local building codes, ICC family of codes, ASCE standards, and industry best practices.
Experience preparing technical reports, engineering calculations, repair recommendations, and investigative findings.
Ability and willingness to travel for site investigations, client meetings, and project-related activities  

Preferred Qualifications & Skills:

Master's degree and or PhD in Structural Engineering or related discipline.
Structural Engineer (SE) license.
Experience providing litigation support, claims consulting, risk management, or insurance-related forensic services.
Established relationships within the legal, insurance, construction, or ownership communities.
Experience supervising entry level engineers.
Excellent analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
Exceptional verbal, written, and presentation skills.
Ability to communicate complex technical information to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Detail-oriented with a commitment to technical excellence.
Highly motivated, proactive, collaborative team player.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously.
Sound engineering judgment and decision-making skills.

At DeSimone Consulting Engineering, we’re committed to transparency—especially when it comes to compensation. The salary range listed reflects what we believe, in good faith, is a fair and competitive range for this role based on the market and location.

This is a salaried, exempt position with an anticipated base salary range of $115,000-$130,000, depending on experience and qualifications. Most candidates are typically hired near the midpoint of the range, ensuring a balanced and equitable approach across our team.

That said, we recognize exceptional talent. In cases where a candidate brings significantly more experience or specialized expertise than required, we may consider an offer toward the higher end of the range. We’re excited you’re considering DeSimone and look forward to learning more about you.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Program Manager, AMXL CX, AMXL CX & Growth
new_jobs.description:
Description

Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) is a single-threaded organization that owns the end-to-end customer experience for heavy and bulky products, from supply chain and fulfillment through transportation, last mile delivery, and post-purchase resolution. AMXL currently operates across North America, Europe, Japan, and is expanding into emerging markets. Within AMXL, the CX and Growth org is a centralized, worldwide team organized across five pillars designed to ensure that every customer who purchases a large, high-value product receives a reliable experience.

The Execution Excellence pillar is where planning meets the customer. It houses two complementary teams: our AMXL Operations Center and our AMXL Proactive Execution program. These teams serve as the real-time network execution backbone, translating strategic decisions into daily network performance across our end-to-end network and also as the mechanism that identifies delivery failures before they become visible to the customer and intervenes proactively to save the delivery or manage the recovery directly with the customer. Together, these teams form a closed loop: detect upstream, prevent where possible, intervene proactively where not, and feed root causes back so defects are resolved at the source.

We are seeking a Senior Program Manager to lead the integration and transformation of this combined organization. This is not a steady-state program management role. The program strategy is being built. You will inherit a consolidation in progress and own the lifecycle of making it work: assessing what the combined org should look like, defining how we measure success, building the mechanisms that make it sustainable, and driving the hard conversations required to get there. You will use process lifecycle evaluation methodologies to categorize the team's portfolio (automate, simplify, reallocate, or deprecate), and build automation roadmaps in partnership with technical teams.

This role requires someone who can operate in high ambiguity, make trade-offs between short-term operational needs and long-term strategic goals, and communicate persuasively across teams. The right candidate sees automation and AI as something they use today, not something they plan to use later, and will set the standard for how this team uses technology to scale impact without scaling headcount.

Key job responsibilities

Define the operating model for the combined organization: org design, process rationalization, scope definition, and mechanisms that make it self-sustaining.
Build the process lifecycle evaluation framework, determining which workflows to automate, simplify, reallocate, or retire, and manage the pipeline of new use cases from scoping through launch.
Own the automation roadmap in partnership with data science, engineering, and technology teams, establishing accountability mechanisms with clear timelines for every manual process.
Drive cross-functional stakeholder alignment across supply chain, quality, and operations, navigating complex organizational dynamics and building trust where needed.
Scale this capability into new geographies by adapting the operating model to local carrier ecosystems, regulatory environments, and workforce availability.

A day in the life

You might start your morning reviewing program metrics dashboards, identifying areas that need attention, and preparing a status narrative for a director-level review. By mid-morning you are facilitating a working session with partners to align on priorities for the quarter. After lunch you dive into data to validate assumptions behind a proposed solution, then draft a decision document that frames trade-offs for leadership. You close the day mentoring a newer program manager and connecting with cross-regional counterparts to keep workstreams on track.

About The Team

The AMXL Customer Experience and Growth team takes a 360-degree approach to the customer journey:

**Eliminate**: detect, solve, and resolve customer-impacting issues upstream by providing relevant and timely insights for operations teams, transportation, and product development.
**Automate**: continuously assess and identify opportunities to replace manual processes with automated, scalable solutions.
**Optimize**: when a customer does need support, ensure AMXL stakeholders have the tools, resources, policies, and protocols to deliver a perfect experience.

The operations center translates strategic decisions into daily network performance. The proactive execution team ensures that when defects occur, customers are protected through early intervention. The Sr. Program Manager will be the link that makes both teams operate as one system.

Basic Qualifications

Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
5+ years of program or project management experience
Experience implementing repeatable processes and driving automation or standardization
Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
Knowledge of general AI tools
Experience defining and executing program requirements
Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred Qualifications

2+ years of driving process improvements experience
Master's degree, or MBA in supply chain, business, engineering, finance or related technical or quantitative field
Experience managing programs across multiple countries and time zones
